findings.text: 长期项目跨会话复用已读材料/经验与任务，命中须回源确认适用版本，合格交付以真实代码/问题完成衡量。
git感知/lazy/watch共享索引，分片持久与目录锁，分层词法/向量召回、TaskBridge、when/guard注入及task/project/global insight。
核共享索引/git清单/分片锁、召回、触发预算、insight草稿/合并/提升、TaskBridge与向量指纹；未穷尽所有UI/符号语言/根解析组合，不运行目标。
MIT0.6.4，Node>=18包声明，pdfjs运行依赖、leanvec optional；源码级范围不等所有依赖代际可安装。

#### 成本

| 阶段 | 现金与资源成本 | 人工与时间投入 | 已知条件与未知项 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 首次使用 | 文件/PDF/符号抽取、可选向量资源 | 选根、去秘密、定任务与知识范围 | 作者79MB为依赖声明，实机峰值/金额未知 |
| 持续使用 | lazy/watch IO、检索、上下文/日志、可选LLM | 核引用、触发截断、近邻与global | 索引无LLM不等总成本零 |
| 失败恢复 | 分片/辅助/global原件与有限备份 | 查锁/源竞态、误合并提升、纠错重建 | 多文件非整库事务，恢复人时未知 |
先单项目非敏感语料和少量人工经验试用，反思/扩展保持默认关；核原文、trigger正文和global，重要规则保权威原件。参见[Q06](#research-q06)。

#### 效果

| 效果项 | 当前证据支持 | 尚不能确定 |
|---|---|---|
| 索引维护 | 哈希增量、分片锁、git语料与定位 | 抽取/源修改竞态及完整覆盖 |
| 召回/提示 | 分层top-k、when/guard与审计 | 相关性/适用真值、长规则完整 |
| 知识治理 | draft隔离、有限prev/删除备份 | 非草稿近邻/全局普适性 |
| 任务续接 | todo/文件绑定和反向同步 | 真实合格率/返工节省 |
共享pipeline、派生链接、目录锁/冲突合并与草稿分支隔离可借鉴；CAS对象是store记录，字符预算与近似向量指纹要明确，勿把原子分片等同整库事务。
将材料召回和行动前须知分契约，结合任务绑定、git语料/分片锁与注入审计减少重复接线，不把相关性当真值。参见[Q01](#research-q01)、[Q02](#research-q02)、[Q03](#research-q03)。
反思草稿已有隔离，但非草稿近邻仍可继承高confidence覆盖全局，任务数提升非适用域验证；trigger也会截断、索引CAS不读源。参见[Q02](#research-q02)、[Q03](#research-q03)、[Q04](#research-q04)。
未验证假设为来源版本/适用域/审批修订链与完整触发引用，先验互斥知识污染和长procedure约束，再比较合格任务及审核负担。参见[Q06](#research-q06)。

technical.rationale: novelty为检索/触发/任务分契约的实质组合而非新RAG算法；mechanism分片锁和分层门控改变维护/召回取舍；transferability能迁移开发记忆但依宿主事件；simplification把正常读文件转维护副产品，收益尚未同条件实测。

business.rationale: workflow跨会话任务续接有实质组织变化；delivery增加可回源记忆/任务交接；reach仍需熟悉项目/审核，有限扩展；economics索引不调模型与少重复读取有局部机制，未测返工/向量成本不夸大。

recommendation.reason: 长期单项目非敏感语料可有限试用，先核引用、触发截断和global；反思默认关闭，近邻/命中不能作为知识验证。

scenario.rationale: 长期开发跨会话复用明确，实际返工收益未测。

advantage.rationale: 任务/分层召回/门控与审计有实质组合。

evidence.rationale: 固定源码关键链，未执行宿主或检索对照。

cost.rationale: 懒索引和预算降低接线，但向量/日志/知识审批恢复需维护。

publication.summaries.text: 索引项目文档与代码符号，分层召回经验和insight，并将任务记录跨会话保存。

items.模型工具: 文档/项目索引、watch/query/stats、经验/insight保存删除及任务工具。
items.用户命令: /tasks工作流入口含任务和记忆子动词。
items.后台: lazy/watch索引、触发/统计注入、审计与可选反思。

publication.capabilities.table:
| 能力 | 主要用途 | 使用条件与边界 |
|---|---|---|
| index_doc | 显式索引一个PDF/MD/txt | 核根与大小；PDF文本非OCR，引用需回源 |
| index_repo | 增量索引项目文档/符号 | 安全根、git清单或遍历；截断/失败有覆盖边界 |
| watch_repo | 开启或停止项目轮询刷新 | watch=false停止；不是实时源版本锁 |
| memory_stats | 查看统计与逐文件索引 | 统计不是质量；根须存在，可选向量可写缓存 |
| query_memory | 按层召回引用和记忆 | 词法/可选语义，分数非真值，扩展可调用模型 |
| remember | 保存问题到解法经验 | 同insight去重；近邻可覆盖，关联文件限项目内 |
| save_lesson | 保存或按id编辑教训/决策/流程 | task/project/global；draft先审，非草稿合并需核 |
| forget | 按id或关键词删除跨层记忆 | 真删除无undo；超上限不删，最近5条有限留痕 |
| list_tasks | 查看含归档的项目任务 | 当前项目根，输出有截断上限 |
| select_task | 绑定/新建/解归档任务并续接 | 精确id或标题；同名多项需选，步骤写回需核 |
| archive_task | 归档任务并停止默认续接 | 精确id；select可恢复，可选反思默认关 |
| show_task_panel | 请求浏览器打开任务面板 | 需客户端结果节点渲染，Host仅返回请求 |
| /tasks | 用户直接驱动任务与记忆子动作 | commands和Web卡片就绪，不经模型工具决策 |
| 自动注入与审计 | when/guard提示及候选解释 | 非执行前强制，字符预算可能截正文 |
| TaskBridge | 同步todo与文件关系 | 子代理不自动建档，模型步骤不等业务验收 |

publication.advice.text: 先单项目非敏感语料和少量人工经验试用，反思/扩展保持默认关；核原文、trigger正文和global，重要规则保权威原件。参见[Q06](#research-q06)。

      "path": "README.md",
      "content": "# dsh-project-memory\n\n> If this plugin saves you an hour of debugging, a star would be appreciated.\n\n[English](README.md) | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)\n\n[![ci](https://github.com/00080000/dsh-project-memory/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/00080000/dsh-project-memory/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE) [![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@yolk_vat-y/dsh-project-memory)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@yolk_vat-y/dsh-project-memory) [![npm downloads](https://img.shields.io/npm/dm/%40yolk_vat-y%2Fdsh-project-memory?style=flat-square&color=orange)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@yolk_vat-y/dsh-project-memory) [![Listed on dsh-plugin.org](https://dsh-plugin.org/badges/listed.svg)](https://dsh-plugin.org/plugins/00080000/dsh-project-memory) [![Awesome](https://awesome-dsh-plugin.com/badge.svg)](https://awesome-dsh-plugin.com)\n\n\nA persistent **project development memory** for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (dsh) agents. Built specifically for project development, natively integrated with dsh's task system: task lists and files read during a session are automatically persisted as cross-session task records, with tasks ↔ files linked — workflows can be switched and resumed, no need to re-scope the whole project, solving context loss. Documents (PDF/Markdown/txt) and code symbols are stored separately per workspace; documents are automatically cross-linked to the code symbols they mention. Experience notes (problem → solution) are automatically deduplicated, preventing repeated mistakes. All data is stored per project on disk, survives session compaction and handover; recalls include `path:line` citations for source verification. No native builds, no vector database. A 79 MB local embedding table (`leanvec`) installs and runs by default; without it, recall falls back to pure lexical.\n\n> The plugin keeps a compact project **memory** on disk, with every entry pointing to a concrete file and line — the agent can reorient quickly instead of re-reading the whole project.\n\n![Task panel: task list, step progress, and involved files](docs/images/image.png)\n\n## Features\n\n- **TaskBridge: cross-session development tasks** — the session's todo list and the files it touches are persisted as per-project task entities, so a workflow can be switched and resumed without re-scoping the project. Associated files stay in recency-weighted order (a read never outranks a written file), so a resumed session sees where to look first. New sessions continue with `list_tasks` → `select_task`. Work delegated to subagents creates no task. On hosts without session events the task tools still work as a plain record list.\n- **Task panel and editing** — draggable cards show a task's steps and files, and can collapse to a mini-bar or be hidden. Title, steps and status can be edited inline, writing back through the same path as model updates; four visual themes change material, geometry, typeface and density only, and colours follow the host. The panel stays hidden until summoned, syncs in the background on session switch, never reopens itself after a refresh, and a render failure cannot take down the host.\n- **Document memory** — PDF, Markdown and plain text are chunked and summarized without a model call. Each entry keeps a short summary for injection, a bounded term set for recall, and a citation back to the source.\n- **Code symbol memory** — a dependency-free scanner extracts functions, classes, methods, interfaces and type aliases with full signatures across 8 languages. Where `typescript` is installed, an optional second layer adds inferred return types, generics and interface shapes; it runs in the background and never blocks indexing.\n- **Automatic, read-time memorization** — a file is memorized the moment the model reads it, so memory is a byproduct of normal work rather than an upfront scan, and files nobody reads are never indexed. A background poll re-memorizes changed files only.\n- **Doc ↔ code cross-linking** — a document that mentions a symbol is surfaced when that symbol is queried. Links are resolved against the current symbol table, so they cannot go stale.\n- **Hybrid recall** — ranked search over documents, symbols, experience notes and insights, with optional LLM query expansion. The experience/insight layers are re-ordered by cosine when `leanvec` is present — installed by default, absent ⇒ pure lexical. Tuned for CJK: phrase boost, a synonym table, and CJK-aware boundaries for doc↔symbol linking.\n- **Experience notes** — problems → solutions, deduplicated by overlap rather than repeated, bounded by project size, and surfaced both by search and by the same injection path as lessons.\n- **Tiered insight memory (lessons / decisions / procedures)** — one entity across task, project and global scope. Near-duplicates merge or reinforce, and promotion moves an entry between scopes instead of copying it. Use is recorded, so decay and capacity rank by activity rather than age alone. The panel exposes a per-scope view for reviewing and editing entries. That list is ordered newest-first and loaded incrementally: 30 entries at a time, with the next page prefetched before the reader reaches the bottom and off-screen rows skipped by the renderer, so a large memory stays responsive.\n- **Triggered injection** — an insight may carry an authored trigger: only `when` triggers, `guard` narrows it, and `prevents` records what breaks without the entry. Corpus text can never trigger an injection; the statistical channel is gated separately and silent by default.\n\n## Installation\n\nThe plugin relies only on stable public APIs declared through peerDependencies.\n\n```bash\ncd dsh-project-memory && dsh plugin --profile web add . -w\n```\n\nThe `-w` (workspace-root) flag is required: the profile directory is a pnpm workspace root, and pnpm rejects `add` there without it. From elsewhere, use the same command with an absolute path.\n\nThe plugin is also published on npm as a scoped package:\n\n```bash\ndsh plugin --profile web add @yolk_vat-y/dsh-project-memory -w\n```\n\nEach indexed project has its own store at `<root>/.dsh-project-memory/`. It keeps itself out of git by default — there is nothing to add to your `.gitignore`.\n\n## Usage\n\nThe tools below are **invoked by the agent**, not typed by the user. In the chat, just ask naturally — e.g. \"index this project\" or \"what does the auth module do?\" — or simply keep working, and the agent calls the matching tool automatically. By default files are indexed the moment the model reads them, so memory fills in while you work. `watch_repo` keeps explicitly-watched roots fresh in the background; `index_repo` forces a full backfill (unchanged files are skipped).\n\nIn a git work tree the corpus is whatever `git ls-files --cached --others --exclude-standard` lists — tracked files plus untracked files that are not ignored — so `.gitignore`, nested rules included, decides what gets remembered. A directory that is not a git work tree falls back to a plain walk (no ignore rules). Lazy indexing applies the same check per file; an explicit `index_doc` always indexes what you point it at.\n\n| Tool | Purpose |\n|---|---|\n| `index_doc file_path` | Index one document (PDF/MD/txt): chunk, summarize deterministically, and store with a `path:line` citation. Unchanged files are skipped. |\n| `index_repo root` | Index a whole project: documents get deterministic summaries, code files get a token-free symbol table. Incremental and self-healing: the store follows the file listing, so deleted, ignored or moved files are dropped, and documents are cross-linked to symbols. A non-existent or excluded root is rejected before anything is written. |\n| `watch_repo root` | Enable automatic refresh: a background poll detects new and changed files and re-indexes only those. Watched roots persist across restarts; a non-existent or excluded root is refused, roots that disappear are dropped rather than re-created. |\n| `memory_stats root` | Show what the store contains: totals, last index time, and the per-file list sorted by recency. |\n| `query_memory query` | Ranked search over documents, symbols, experience and insights, optionally query-expanded by the LLM. `type` selects a layer (`all` / `doc` / `symbol` / `experience` / `insight` / `task`). Returns hits with relative scores, sources or insight ids, and doc→symbol references. |\n| `list_tasks` | List task records for the project (archived marked). Call first in a new session before continuing work. |\n| `select_task` | Bind the session to a task so its todo list and file reads sync into it. Exact `taskId`, or exact `title` (multiple matches return candidates; no match creates a new task). Pass `title` with `taskId` to rename. Auto-unarchives. |\n| `archive_task` | Archive a task (hide from default views, exclude from capacity, stop syncing). `select_task` restores it. |\n| `show_task_panel` | Show the task panel in the UI. Call when the user asks to see the task list or when you want to display the panel. |\n| `/tasks` (typed by the user, not the model) | The only user command: shows the task stack and drives the workflow card. Every other action is a **sub-verb** invoked by card buttons: `switch` / `archive` / `unbind` / `rename` / `todos …` / `step` / `step-move` / `step-text` for tasks, `insight list [scope] [offset] [limit]` / `confirm` / `promote` / `demote` / `archive` / `restore` / `delete` / `save` / `edit` for memory. |\n| `remember problem solution` | Save an experience note. It is a `kind: 'experience'` insight — same store, same dedup and same delete path as lessons / decisions / procedures. Similar problems merge or overwrite instead of duplicating. |\n| `forget id_or_query` | Delete memories — lessons / decisions / procedures and experience notes alike, across task / project / global in one call, without knowing which layer the entry lives in. An exact id deletes that one entry; keywords match by **query-side coverage** (matched query terms ÷ query terms). Real deletion, no undo; when keywords match more than the cap (default 10) it deletes nothing and only lists the candidates. The **5** most recently deleted entries are kept as full entries in that layer's `deleted.json` next to its store (`<root>/.dsh-project-memory/deleted.json` for the project layer, beside the global file for global), and the deletion result prints that path — read it and save again to recover a mis-delete. |\n| `save_lesson` | Save a lesson / decision / procedure at task, project or global scope; passing `id` **overwrites that entry in place** (only the fields you pass, the previous values stay in `prev` — write them back with the same id). Before writing it compares against existing memory: cosine ≥ 0.9 auto-overwrites that entry, ≥ 0.7 reports the nearest id in the result; without `leanvec` it falls back to lexical overlap ≥ 0.7 merge / 0.65–0.7 reinforce. Two tasks hitting the same insight promote it task → project, three or more → global. Key params: `id`, `title`, `kind`, `scope`, the content (`pattern`/`fix`, `choice`/`reason` or `steps`), and `trigger` (`when` is the only trigger surface, `guard` narrows it, `prevents` records what breaks without it). |\n\n`/tasks` appears in the web `/` menu inside an icon-bearing **Workflow** group, with three view entries — Tasks / Project Memory / Global Memory (labelled in the UI language). It is the plugin's only registered command; every other action rides it as a sub-verb driven by card buttons.\n\n## How it works\n\nThe design follows four principles:\n\n- **Volatility** — context is ephemeral; it is lost when a session is compacted.\n- **Persistence** — the **memory** is stored on disk and survives compaction and new sessions.\n- **Compactness** — one bounded declaration line per symbol, and a ≤300-char summary plus a bounded term set per document chunk. Derived data is never stored: doc→symbol links are computed at read time. Index size depends on symbol density and chunk length, so treat these as measurements of specific corpora (2026-10-13), not guarantees: a code-only frontend app (289 files) lands at **325 bytes/entry ≈ 21% of source**, a symbol-dense TypeScript monorepo (12,634 files / 107 MB of code + 14 MB of docs) at **22% of source for the code layer (549 bytes/entry overall)** and **127% for the document layer**, and a document-heavy workspace (Markdown + PDFs) at **1,401 bytes/entry**.\n- **Verifiability** — **recalls** carry a `path:line` citation where applicable, so the agent can confirm details against the source.\n\nBuilding the **memory** does not require an upfront scan: files are memorized as the model reads them, so the **memory** grows to cover exactly what has been worked with. Re-reading an unchanged file is a no-op, so the **memory** stays fresh with minimal ongoing overhead.\n\nThe store is per-project and follows the codebase: changed files are re-extracted by content hash, deleted files are removed. Experience notes are `kind: 'experience'` entries in `insights.json` — retrieval-only, so accumulation does not affect context.\n\n## Design\n\n```\n.dsh-project-memory/\n  format.json      layout marker (v2, sharded)\n  shards/          one self-describing JSON per indexed source file — writes touch only dirty shards\n  watch.json       watched roots\n  tasks.json       TaskBridge task entities (cross-session)\n  binding.json     current session ↔ task binding\n  insights.json    project-scope memory (lessons / decisions / procedures / experience notes) — one entity\n  vectors.json     optional semantic index (only when the vector layer runs)\n  injection-audit.jsonl   one line per real injection (what / why / dropped / budget)\n  admission-shadow.jsonl  one line per step, all scored candidates + features (offline replay)\n```\n\n- **Incremental** — a content hash per file; only changed files are re-extracted.\n- **Cross-linking** — a returned document chunk resolves the symbols it mentions against the **current** symbol table and appends them as `references`, so a doc indexed before its symbols still links correctly.\n- **Query expansion** — when enabled, `query_memory` asks the LLM to rewrite the query into several variants (synonyms, EN/CN, identifier guesses) and merges the scores; when off, queries never touch the LLM. Indexing itself is model-free.\n- **Consistency** — the fact layer follows the codebase (hash re-extract / remove-on-delete); the experience layer is retrieval-only with supersede and `forget`. Writes take a cross-process directory lock (`.write.lock`) around a short read-modify-write, so two dsh instances can share one project store: shards converge by `indexedAt`, and a save that cannot get the lock is deferred and retried.\n\n## Architecture (Task Panel)\n\n```\nTaskPanel (Container)\n├── task-data-store  (server data, cross-tab sync via BroadcastChannel)\n├── task-ui-store    (local UI state, localStorage)\n├── task-hooks       (useTaskDrag, useTaskEdit)\n└── TaskComponents   (MiniBar, TaskCard — presentational only)\n```\n\nThe workflow panel is collapsible, adapts to dsh and theme plugin styles, and offers four card styles.\n\n![Four card styles](docs/images/image-4.png)\n\n## Configuration\n\n| Key | Default | Meaning |\n|---|---|---|\n| `memoryDir` | `.dsh-project-memory` | store directory inside each indexed root |\n| `chunkChars` / `maxChunksPerFile` | 3000 / 40 | max chars per document chunk, max chunks per document |\n| `maxFileSizeMb` | 10 | skip documents (incl. PDF) and code files larger than this (MB); see the per-file memory budget below |\n| `maxPdfPages` | 1000 | PDF page cap |\n| `maxOutputChars` | 8000 | cap for `query_memory` result text (chars) |\n| `lazyIndexing` | true | index files the moment the model reads them |\n| `autoIndexOnFirstUse` | false | full scan of the current working directory on plugin load (opt-in) |\n| `watch` / `watchInterval` | true / 30 | background refresh; base poll interval in seconds (polls stay quiet while a turn is running — a 5-minute fallback keeps external edits fresh — and one merged scan runs at turn end; idle polls back off up to 2 minutes and reset on any change) |\n| `maxScanFiles` / `maxScanDepth` | 20000 / 12 | per-scan caps on files and directory depth; a truncated pass is reported and never removes what it did not reach. Cannot be disabled: `0` or any invalid value falls back to the default |\n| `allowUnsafeRoots` | false | allow **explicit** tool calls to target a directory on the excluded list. Lazy indexing, session audit and TaskBridge always stay inert there; `autoIndexOnFirstUse` does not — this flag releases it too |\n| `llmQueryExpansion` / `expansionCount` | false / 6 | expand queries via the LLM before search (off by default to save tokens); max variants |\n| `tsPath` / `enableTypeScript` | (auto) / true | optional absolute path to a specific `typescript` install; set `enableTypeScript: false` to disable the type-aware layer entirely |\n| `tasklist.enabled` / `tasklist.syncHostOnAdopt` | true / true | TaskBridge auto-sync (task entities from the session todo list and file reads); push a bound task's steps to the host task list so dsh mirrors it |\n| `insight.*` | dedupOverlap `0.7` · reinforceBand `0.65` · autoMergeCos `0.9` · autoMergeMargin `0.05` · hintCos `0.7` · maxForgetMatches `10` · maxProject `100` · maxGlobalProcedures `200` · promoteConfidence `0.7` · globalPromoteTasks `3` · decayDays `90` · `globalFile` (auto) | insight dedupe / auto-overwrite / near-neighbour hint / delete cap / reinforce / promotion / capacity / archive settings. `autoMergeCos` / `hintCos` = `0` turns that band **off** |\n| `reflection.enabled` | false | LLM reflection, **draft-only at task level** (fires on task switch-away / archive). `cooldownMs` `1800000`, `maxLessonsPerReflect` `3`, `maxDecisionsPerReflect` `2` |\n| `autoContext.enabled` | true | silent injection wrapper (resident task card + gated items); inert until the host exposes a resolvable session cwd. `maxTokens` `400` (per step), `editedMax` `3` (recently written files shown on the task card), `signalMinRatio` `0.5` (a hint must reach half of its layer's top score), `skipEchoSelfTodo` `true`, `budgetLog` `off`, `reinjectItemsAfter` `0` (steps before the same insight may be injected again), `rootNotice` `true` |\n| `autoContext.gateCooldownSteps` | 2 | minimum number of pre-steps between two *item* injections (the resident task card is exempt — it is a state snapshot). This is the main \"don't inject often\" dial |\n| `autoContext.maxItemsPerSession` / `autoContext.maxItemCharsPerSession` | 60 / 24000 | **runaway fuse, not a throttle** — a hard per-session ceiling by count and characters; once reached, the item channel stays silent for the rest of the session |\n| `autoContext.hintMinCoverage` | 0.45 | **absolute** floor for the statistical channel: the IDF-weighted share of the query's information mass the entry covers. A ratio-only threshold cannot tell signal from \"best of a bad lot\" |\n| `autoContext.hintMinMatched` / `autoContext.hintMinSupport` | 2 / 0.15 | a hint must share at least this many terms with the query, and at least this share of the query's terms must exist in the corpus at all — otherwise the channel stays silent this round |\n| `autoContext.vectorDir` | unset | **optional** semantic layer over the experience/insight layers, on by default via the `leanvec` optionalDependency (79 MB, ≈+130 MB RSS). `off` forces pure lexical; a path or `DSH_LEANVEC_DIR` overrides it. Re-orders only, returned counts unchanged; while it is active only entries that got **no** cosine are still filtered by lexical match count |\n| `autoContext.vectorAlpha` | 0.5 | weight of `(1-α)·lexical + α·cosine` in those layers; `0` disables re-ranking only (write-side dedup stays on), `1` (pure vector) measured worse |\n| `autoContext.vectorDedup` | true | write-side near-duplicate detection (cosine ≥ 0.9 auto-overwrite, ≥ 0.7 near-neighbour hint). Independent of `vectorAlpha`; `false` keeps recall ranking untouched |\n| `autoContext.vectorItemMin` / `autoContext.vectorSpeakMin` | unset | **experimental** absolute-cosine gates for the hint channel (per-entry floor / channel-level semantic rescue). Uncalibrated — unset means off; see the evidence in `src/auto-inject.js` before enabling |\n| `autoContext.legacyScope` | `ignore` | how a legacy `trigger.scope` is treated: `ignore` (default) does not use it as a filter; `filter` applies it as a filter. `npm run selfcheck:triggers` lists entries that still carry a scope |\n| `autoContext.auditLog` | true | append one JSONL line per **actual** injection to `injection-audit.jsonl` (what / why / dropped / budget); rotates to `.1` past `auditMaxBytes` (`262144`). Silent on I/O errors |\n| `autoContext.shadowLog` / `autoContext.shadowMaxBytes` | true / 524288 | append one JSONL line **per step** (including steps that injected nothing) to `admission-shadow.jsonl`: scored candidates with their features and the gate that rejected each one — what makes a threshold change answerable offline. Disk only, never in the prompt; rotates keeping one `.1` generation |\n\n### Toggling features\n\nThe two most relevant switches are `lazyIndexing` (index a file the moment the model reads it; default on) and `autoIndexOnFirstUse` (full scan of the current working directory on plugin load; default off). Lazily indexed project roots are automatically registered with the watcher, so changed files stay fresh without an explicit `watch_repo`.\n\n**Root resolution.** In order: an explicit `root` argument; a registered root (`watch_repo`); the nearest ancestor with a VCS marker (`.git`/`.hg`/`.svn`) or a build/manifest marker (`package.json`, `go.mod`, `Cargo.toml`, `pyproject.toml`, …); the session working directory, unless it is on the excluded list. A file that matches none of these is not indexed.\n\nWhen the root comes from the working directory, the model gets one notice per session naming it and how to change it; mute with `autoContext.rootNotice: false`. Starting dsh in a container directory such as `~/workspace` therefore makes that directory the root, and memory spans everything beneath it up to the scan limit — start dsh inside the project for one store per project.\n\n**Excluded directories.** Not used as a root, matched exactly (subdirectories are unaffected): the filesystem root, the home directory, temp directories — `os.tmpdir()` and the shared ones (`/tmp`, `/var/tmp`, `%TEMP%`, `%SystemRoot%\\Temp`) — and system / package-manager prefixes (`/opt/homebrew` on POSIX; `%SystemRoot%`, `%ProgramFiles%`, `%ProgramData%` on Windows). A session in one of these runs without memory, with one line on stderr.\n\n**Scan limits.** One pass covers at most `maxScanFiles` files (20000) and `maxScanDepth` directory levels (12). A truncated pass is reported in the `index_repo` result and logged once per root by the watcher, and it does not remove entries it did not reach. A directory that cannot be read (e.g. `EACCES`) counts as a truncated pass too and is named in the result: a read failure is not a deletion.\n\n**Per-file memory budget.** `maxFileSizeMb` is a memory gate, not a disk-space preference. Indexing a file first materializes it — the whole buffer plus decoded text for code, or every PDF page's text plus the joined markdown for documents — and the peak scales with the file's size. Measured on this machine with `npm run bench:peak` (peak RSS fitted against disk size over a 1–50 MB ladder, one fresh process per point): **≈10×** for typical source code (1 declaration per ~1.4 KB), **≈22×** for symbol-dense code (1 per 220 B) and **≈20×** for a text-heavy PDF, on top of a ~52 MB process baseline plus a one-off ≈175 MB the first time a PDF is parsed. The 10 MB default therefore keeps a single file at roughly **+300 MB RSS** for code and **+370 MB** for a PDF; raising the cap raises that ceiling proportionally.\n\nThe store lives in the tree it indexes and **ignores itself**: a `*` rule inside the store keeps it out of `git status` and `git add -A`, and means `git clean -fd` leaves it alone. The first query after a write rebuilds the IDF cache (**141 ms at 40k entries**, 68 ms at 20k, 17 ms at 4k); later queries hit it.\n\n### Reproduce it on your own project\n\nThe measurement ships with the repository **and with the published npm package** (`scripts/` is part of the tarball). It needs **no dsh instance, no network and no model calls**, and never touches your project's own store — results go to a temp directory and are removed afterwards:\n\n```bash\nnpm run bench -- /path/to/your/project\n# or, with options:\nnode scripts/bench.mjs /path/to/your/project [--json] [--samples 100] [--no-pdf] [--keep]\n```\n\nIt reports the cold index split into read+hash / extract / commit, cold load, IDF rebuild, cold and hot query latency (p50/p95/max over 100 sampled queries through the shipped scorer), single-file hot re-index, store size, resident heap and bytes per entry. Example — the frontend app row above:\n\n```\ncold index   246 ms   (read+hash 8 ms · extract 222 ms · commit 14 ms)   ← 2nd, warm-cache run\nstore        0.66 MB content · 1.52 MB on disk · 325 bytes/entry · cold load 8 ms\nmemory       heap 6.3 MB after load → 6.9 MB after the first query (RSS 62 MB)\nhot query    p50 0.76 ms · p95 1.4 ms          (2,142 entries)\nre-index 1 file  p50 0.3 ms\n```\n\nPass `--queries your-queries.json` to run the labeled-set method (hit@5 / hit@10 / MRR) against your own project.\n\n## Design tradeoffs\n\n- **A short filesystem lock, not an embedded database** — each save holds an exclusive `.write.lock` only for the read-modify-write (parsing stays outside it), waits at most 2 s for a busy peer and then retries. Two dsh instances can share one store. No WAL, no daemon, no native dependency.\n- **Watch: compute outside, commit inside** — no lock is held during parsing, and polling with mtime + content hash is used instead of `fs.watch`: it behaves identically on network drives, Docker volumes and WSL, without duplicate-trigger or missed-event failure modes.\n- **Corrupt shards are quarantined, not repaired** — a shard that fails to parse is renamed and only that file is re-indexed, so there is no WAL or embedded database adding native dependencies, lock contention and failure modes of their own.\n- **Vectors re-rank, they do not rank** — on a paraphrased-query set, pure vector replacement is worse than BM25 (hit@10 **53% vs 69%**) while weighted fusion helps at small k (hit@3 **53% vs 50%**), so the optional layer only re-orders the experience/insight layers and never gates. Lexical retrieval still answers the queries this plugin targets: on a real project with 29 labelled queries, file-level hit@5 is **96.6%**, and whole-chunk terms raise document term coverage from **27.3% to 100%** with MRR unchanged (**0.958** vs **0.955**).\n- **Indexing is deterministic and model-free** — a model at index time would make two indexings of one document differ, and a wrong translation at query time means zero recall; rules plus symbol links cover the common cases and work offline.\n- **Model-facing memory: the agent writes, no human in the loop** — the consumer is the agent, usually headless, so memory that only promotes when someone clicks a card would never promote at all. `draft` is a provenance marker plus an evidence threshold, not an approval queue.\n- **Full entries returned directly** — entries are already compact, so returning them whole is more verifiable and one round-trip cheaper.\n- **`forget` by query is aggressive; use IDs for precision** — experience notes are low-risk, high-volume and retrieval-only, so stale noise hurts more than an over-broad delete. For exact deletion use the ID shown by `query_memory`.\n- **TypeScript enhancement is optional, lazy and cached** — it runs in the background, never blocks indexing, and falls back to the regex scanner; its queue is bounded, and any dropped files are reported. The **default lib is not loaded**: inference that depends on global types (`Promise`/`Array`/DOM) degrades to `any`/`unknown`, while explicit annotations are unaffected.\n- **Subagent sessions are out of scope**\n\n## Development (for contributors)\n\nThese commands are for **maintaining the plugin code** — regular users do not need them. Installing the plugin only requires the command in [Installation](#installation).\n\n```bash\nnpm install\nnpm test                    # 756 tests\nnpm run eval:injection      # synthetic pool P/R: precision 0.93 / recall 1.00, + a 3-scenario hint-only group\nnpm run eval:injection -- --store .dsh-project-memory/insights.json   # replay on YOUR store; control group is a hard gate\nnpm run selfcheck:triggers  # which entries can still push, which declarations are dead (reads your local store)\nnpm run bench -- /path/to/project   # index/query performance on any project — no dsh needed\nnpm run bench:peak          # peak-RSS budget of maxFileSizeMb, measured on a 1–50 MB ladder\nnpm run schema:size         # per-tool fixed prompt cost: chars and a same-scale token estimate\n```\n\nRelease notes live in [`CHANGELOG.md`](CHANGELOG.md) and on [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/00080000/dsh-project-memory/releases).\n\n## License\n\nMIT — see [`LICENSE`](LICENSE).\n\nCopyright (c) 2026 00080000 <3388065969@qq.com>\n"

      "content": "// 索引一个文件的**唯一**实现。\n//\n// 这段逻辑以前在 index_repo（批量）、watch（轮询）、lazy（fs/observed 懒索引）里各抄一份，\n// 三份随后各自打补丁、已经漂移：index_repo 多一道冗余的 dump 预检、体积超限时删旧记录，\n// 而 watch/lazy 保留旧记录；terms 回填与单次读盘的写法也各不相同。\n// 现在「这个文件该不该读、读出来该写什么条目」只在这里定义一次；\n// 调用方只保留自己的编排（批量计数、watch 的 mtime 快照、lazy 的根解析与副作用）。\nimport { statSync } from 'node:fs'\nimport { isSupportedCode, isSupportedDoc, readFileForIndex } from './util/fs.js'\nimport { buildDocEntries } from './doc-pipeline.js'\nimport { docEntriesNeedBackfill } from './doc-index.js'\nimport { scanSymbols } from './symbols.js'\n\n/** 不索引的后缀。 */\nexport const UNSUPPORTED = 'unsupported'\n/** 代码文件超过 maxFileSizeMb：读盘成本不抵符号表收益。 */\nexport const OVERSIZE = 'oversize'\n/** 内容哈希未变，且无需回填词项。 */\nexport const UNCHANGED = 'unchanged'\n/** 文档不可索引（dump / 抽取返回 null）→ 从 store 移除。 */\nexport const DROP = 'drop'\n/** 有内容要写入 store。 */\nexport const WRITE = 'write'\n\n/** 后缀 → 'code' | 'doc' | null。 */\nexport function fileKind(ext) {\n  if (isSupportedCode(ext)) return 'code'\n  if (isSupportedDoc(ext)) return 'doc'\n  return null\n}\n\nfunction exceedsSizeCap(kind, size, config) {\n  return kind === 'code' && !!config.maxFileSizeMb && size > config.maxFileSizeMb * 1024 * 1024\n}\n\n/**\n * 读取 + 判重 + 抽条目。抛出的异常（读盘失败、PDF 解析失败……）由调用方按各自策略处理：\n * index_repo 收进 failures 汇总，watch 去重打印并可重试，lazy 记一行日志。\n *\n * @returns {{key: string, hash?: string, size?: number, type?: string, entries?: object[]}}\n *   key 为 UNSUPPORTED / OVERSIZE / UNCHANGED / DROP / WRITE 之一。\n * @param {object} args\n * @param {number} [args.size] 调用方已 statSync 时传入，避免重复 stat。\n * @param {boolean} [args.force] index_repo 的 reindex：忽略哈希跳过。\n */\nexport async function planFileIndex({ rel, filePath, kind, config, record, existingEntries = [], size, force = false }) {\n  if (!kind) return { key: UNSUPPORTED }\n  const fileSize = typeof size === 'number' ? size : statSync(filePath).size\n  if (exceedsSizeCap(kind, fileSize, config)) return { key: OVERSIZE }\n\n  // 单次读盘：同一 buffer 供内容哈希与正文解码使用（未变更的文件不解码）。\n  const { hash, buffer } = readFileForIndex(filePath)\n  // 旧 store 的 doc 条目缺 terms → 即使哈希未变也重抽一次（一次性回填）。\n  const backfill = kind === 'doc' && docEntriesNeedBackfill(existingEntries)\n  if (!force && record && record.sha256 === hash && !backfill) return { key: UNCHANGED }\n\n  if (kind === 'code') {\n    return { key: WRITE, hash, size: fileSize, type: 'code', entries: scanSymbols(rel, filePath, buffer.toString('utf8')) }\n  }\n  // dump 判定在 buildDocEntries 内部（唯一真源）：不可索引的文档返回 null。\n  const entries = await buildDocEntries(rel, filePath, {\n    chunkChars: config.chunkChars,\n    maxChunks: config.maxChunksPerFile,\n    maxFileSizeMb: config.maxFileSizeMb,\n    maxPdfPages: config.maxPdfPages,\n  })\n  return entries === null ? { key: DROP } : { key: WRITE, hash, size: fileSize, type: 'doc', entries }\n}\n\n/**\n * plan → 落盘用的更新记录。只接受 DROP / WRITE：UNCHANGED / OVERSIZE 由调用方自己跳过，\n * 误传会直接抛错——静默写进一条 entries=undefined 的记录才是真正的坑。\n * `expectedHash` 是 CAS 基准：扫描之后文件又被改动时，commit 会拒绝这次写入，\n * 调用方据此回滚自己的快照（见 commitFileUpdates 的返回值）。\n */\nexport function toFileUpdate(rel, plan, record) {\n  if (plan.key === DROP) return { rel, drop: true }\n  if (plan.key !== WRITE) throw new Error(`toFileUpdate: unexpected plan key ${plan.key}`)\n  return {\n    rel,\n    expectedHash: record?.sha256 ?? null,\n    hash: plan.hash,\n    size: plan.size,\n    type: plan.type,\n    entries: plan.entries,\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n * 一批更新一次性落盘：写入 / 移除 → 清掉本轮未见到的旧条目。\n * 单事务的好处是 store 只 save 一次，watch 每轮不会反复重写。\n *\n * 不再重建 doc↔symbol 链接：链接是读取期解算的派生关系（见 src/link.js），\n * 所以这里也没有了那个「中间批次跳过链接、最后一批统一做」的 `link` 参数。\n *\n * @returns {{stale: string[], removed: number}} stale 是 CAS 失败（并发改动）的 rel，\n *   调用方应让它们保持「未落快照」状态，下一轮重试。\n */\nexport function commitFileUpdates(store, { updates, unseen = null }) {\n  const stale = []\n  let removed = 0\n  store.commit((s) => {\n    for (const update of updates) {\n      if (update.drop) {\n        s.removeFile(update.rel)\n        continue\n      }\n      if (!s.applyFileUpdate(update.rel, update)) stale.push(update.rel)\n    }\n    if (unseen) {\n      for (const rel of Object.keys(s.files)) {\n        if (!unseen.has(rel)) {\n          s.removeFile(rel)\n          removed++\n        }\n      }\n    }\n  })\n  return { stale, removed }\n}\n"

      "content": "import { readFile } from 'node:fs/promises'\n\nlet pdfjsPromise\nlet configuredWorkerSrc\n\nfunction loadPdfjs() {\n  if (!pdfjsPromise) {\n    pdfjsPromise = import('pdfjs-dist/legacy/build/pdf.mjs')\n      .then((mod) => {\n        if (configuredWorkerSrc) {\n          mod.GlobalWorkerOptions.workerSrc = configuredWorkerSrc\n        }\n        return mod\n      })\n      .catch((err) => {\n        pdfjsPromise = undefined\n        throw err\n      })\n  }\n  return pdfjsPromise\n}\n\nconst PDFJS_OPTIONS = {\n  useSystemFonts: true,\n  isEvalSupported: false,\n  useWorkerFetch: false,\n  useWorker: false,\n  // 0 = ERRORS。损坏/线性化缺失的 PDF 会让 pdf.js 打 \"Warning: Indexing all PDF objects\"\n  // 之类的告警——那是它自己的恢复路径，对使用者没有可操作性，静音。\n  verbosity: 0,\n}\n\nfunction buildMarkdown(pages) {\n  return pages\n    .map((p) => (pages.length > 1 ? `## Page ${p.page}\\n\\n${p.text}` : p.text))\n    .join('\\n\\n')\n}\n\nfunction extractPageText(items) {\n  const lines = []\n  let currentY = null\n  let currentLine = ''\n  for (const item of items) {\n    if (!item.str || !item.str.trim()) continue\n    const y = item.transform ? item.transform[5] : 0\n    if (currentY === null || Math.abs(y - currentY) < 2) {\n      currentY = y\n      currentLine += (currentLine && !currentLine.endsWith(' ') ? {\n            totalTextChars,\n            avgImagesPerPage: sampledPages ? imageCount / sampledPages : 0,\n          }\n        : undefined,\n    }\n  } finally {\n    await loadingTask.destroy()\n  }\n}\n\nexport function configurePdfjsWorker(workerSrc) {\n  configuredWorkerSrc = workerSrc\n  if (pdfjsPromise) {\n    pdfjsPromise.then((mod) => {\n      mod.GlobalWorkerOptions.workerSrc = workerSrc\n    })\n  }\n}"

''))\n    .filter((t) => CJK_RANGE.test(t) || t.length >= MIN_LATIN_QUERY_TERM)\n    .join(' ')\n}\n\n/**\n * 最小相关性闸门：命中的**不同查询词数**至少 min(2, 查询词数)。\n *\n * 为什么需要：`score > 0` 不是\"相关\"的证据。实测把 `zzz-no-such-topic-xyz` 丢进 query_memory，\n * 它命中了 1 条无关经验——因为查询被 `-` 切出的 2 字符片段 `no` 恰好是那条经验里的一个真实 token\n * （来自 `git commit --amend --no-edit`），于是单个片段就拿走了 3.13 分。提示通道早就有这条规则\n * （`hintMinMatched`，默认 min(2, 词数)），**工具路径与这两层一直漏着**。\n *\n * ⚠ **只对没有语义分的条目生效**，而且是**逐条**判——不是\"有 rerank 就整条关掉\"。这是同查询集\n * A/B 实测出来的（36 条、同一个 store）：\n *   · 纯词法下加闸门：BM25 的 hit@1/3/5/10 = 39/50/58/69% **完全不变**，只是不再对乱码查询出声；\n *   · 有向量时对**所有**条目加闸门：融合 hit@5/10 从 64/72% 掉到 58/64%，\"完全没召回\"从 10 涨到 13。\n * 原因是结构性的：**向量救回来的那批，恰恰就是词法弱到不足 2 个命中的**——用词法的尺子去筛，\n * 等于把向量的全部价值砍掉。所以：拿到语义分的条目豁免，没拿到的照旧过闸。\n *\n * 旧实现按 `Boolean(rerank)` 整条关闸，于是\"装了 leanvec 但这一轮给不出余弦\"（查询编码失败、\n * embed 抛异常、或者根本没有候选可编码）时，弱命中会漏进来——那不是降级，是**换了行为**：\n * 注释承诺的\"逐字段退回纯词法\"在那种情况下并不成立。\n *\n * 只作用于 experience / insight 两层：它们是短标题语料，单片段命中几乎没有证据力；\n * doc/symbol 层是代码与路径（`js` / `id` 这类单词查询本来就该命中），不动它。\n * 单词查询不受影响：need = min(2, 1) = 1，与\"score>0 即命中\"等价。\n */\nfunction matchedFloor(scored, queries) {\n  const qTokens = new Set()\n  for (const q of queries) for (const t of tokenizeRaw(String(q ?? ''))) qTokens.add(t)\n  const need = Math.min(2, qTokens.size)\n  if (need <= 1) return scored\n  // `typeof vector === 'number'` 只在融合真给出了有限余弦时为真（见 fuseVectorHits）。\n  return scored.filter((r) => typeof r.vector === 'number' || (r.matched ?? 0) >= need)\n}\n\n/** 各层先验：insight 是\"踩过的坑\"，略高于普通文档；经验笔记（同库、kind 区分）留痕价值略低。 */\nexport const LAYER_PRIORS = Object.freeze({\n  insight: 1.15,\n  doc: 1,\n  symbol: 1,\n  experience: 0.9,\n})\n\n/** 规范段词集（多语言、确定性）：标题命中即视为\"规约/清单\"段。 */\nexport const NORMATIVE_HEADING =\n  /(必须|禁止|不得|不要|铁律|规约|规范|规则|约定|清单|检查表|checklist|rules?|requirements?|must|must not|do not|don't|never)/i\n\n/** 规范段提权倍数。取 1.5 与 CJK 短语加成同量级：足以翻转词频差，不足以压过强命中。 */\nexport const NORMATIVE_PRIOR = 1.5\n\n/**\n * 规范段先验：doc 条目标题命中规范词集时提权，其余条目恒为 1。\n * @param {{ title?: string }} entry - 任意检索条目（通常是 doc chunk）。\n * @returns {number} 1 或 {@link NORMATIVE_PRIOR}。\n */\nexport function normativePrior(entry) {\n  return NORMATIVE_HEADING.test(String(entry?.title || '')) ? NORMATIVE_PRIOR : 1\n}\n\n/**\n * 一条 insight 的正文文本（用于展示、注入与检索兜底）。\n * 顺序即优先级：fix > choice > solution > pattern/problem > body > steps。\n * @param {object} ins - 归一化后的 insight 条目。\n * @returns {string} 单行正文。\n */\nexport function insightBodyText(ins) {\n  const parts = []\n  if (ins?.fix) parts.push(ins.fix)\n  else if (ins?.choice) parts.push(ins.choice)\n  else if (ins?.solution) parts.push(ins.solution)\n  else if (ins?.pattern) parts.push(ins.pattern)\n  else if (ins?.problem) parts.push(ins.problem)\n  else if (ins?.body) parts.push(ins.body)\n  if (ins?.reason) parts.push(`理由：${ins.reason}`)\n  if (Array.isArray(ins?.steps) && ins.steps.length) {\n    parts.push(ins.steps.map((s, i) => `${i + 1}. ${s}`).join(' '))\n  }\n  return parts.filter(Boolean).join(' ')\n}\n\n/**\n * insight → 统一检索条目契约的适配器。\n * 复用 doc 条目的字段语义，于是 title×5 字段加权、CJK 短语加成、IDF 打分全部现成可用。\n * @param {object} ins - 归一化后的 insight 条目。\n * @returns {object} 检索条目（额外字段仅供渲染，不参与打分）。\n */\nexport function insightToEntry(ins) {\n  const derived = ins?.triggerDerived || {}\n  const keywords = [\n    ins?.kind,\n    ins?.scope,\n    ...(Array.isArray(ins?.files) ? ins.files : []),\n    ...(Array.isArray(ins?.symbols) ? ins.symbols : []),\n    ...(Array.isArray(ins?.tags) ? ins.tags : []),\n    // 派生信号（PR3）：只提升召回，不参与强制注入\n    ...(Array.isArray(derived.keywords) ? derived.keywords : []),\n    ...(Array.isArray(derived.actions) ? derived.actions : []),\n  ].filter(Boolean)\n  return {\n    id: `insight:${ins?.id}`,\n    insightId: ins?.id,\n    type: 'insight',\n    kind: ins?.kind,\n    scope: ins?.scope,\n    confidence: ins?.confidence,\n    // 上一版被覆盖的字段：pull 侧要能显示，模型才知道能不能写回。\n    prev: ins?.prev && typeof ins.prev === 'object' ? ins.prev : undefined,\n    files: Array.isArray(ins?.files) ? ins.files : [],\n    symbols: Array.isArray(ins?.symbols) ? ins.symbols : [],\n    title: String(ins?.title || '(untitled)'),\n    summary: insightBodyText(ins).slice(0, 300),\n    // 检索用词项：pattern/problem/reason 是\"症状\"侧词汇，fix 已在 summary 里（title×5 之外单算 1 份）。\n    terms: [ins?.pattern, ins?.problem, ins?.reason, ...(Array.isArray(derived.paths) ? derived.paths : [])].filter(Boolean).join(' '),\n    keywords,\n    sourcePath: Array.isArray(ins?.files) && ins.files.length ? ins.files[0] : '',\n    status: 'exact',\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n * 一条 insight 的**打分文本**（BM25 与 IDF 覆盖率必须用同一份）。\n *\n * 为什么要有这个函数：提示通道的\"这条查询离语料有多远\"（`idfCoverage` 的 df）曾经用\n * `insightMatchText` 计算，而排序用 `insightToEntry`（含 fix/solution/reason/steps）。\n * 于是\"只在解药里有匹配\"的查询词 df=0 → supportRatio=0 → **整条提示通道本轮沉默**，\n * 而排序明明给了它高分。两份文本永远来自同一个 entry，才不会再漂移。\n * @param {object} ins\n * @returns {string}\n */\nexport function insightScoringText(ins) {\n  const e = insightToEntry(ins)\n  return [e.title, e.summary, e.terms, ...(e.keywords || [])].filter(Boolean).join('\\n')\n}\n\n/**\n * 召回可见的 insight 集合：作用域可见性跟随会话绑定。\n *   - project / global：始终可见（归档除外）；\n *   - task：只在该会话绑定了对应任务时可见（任务私有，不泄露给别的会话）；\n *   - `kind:'experience'`（v0.4 经验笔记，加载时导入）**也在这里**——统一存储后没有第二个真相源，\n *     它由 experience 那一桶按 kind 取走；本函数不做排除（排除会让同一内容在别的视图里消失）。\n * @param {{ store?: object, globalStore?: object, boundTaskId?: string|null }} opts\n * @returns {object[]} 可检索的 insight 条目。\n */\nexport function visibleInsights({ store = null, globalStore = null, boundTaskId = null } = {}) {\n  const out = []\n  for (const it of (store && typeof store.insightItems === 'function' ? store.insightItems() : []) || []) {\n    if (!it || it.archived) continue\n    if (it.scope === 'task') continue\n    if (it.draft === true) continue\n    out.push(it)\n  }\n  for (const it of (globalStore && typeof globalStore.items === 'function' ? globalStore.items() : []) || []) {\n    if (!it || it.archived || it.draft === true) continue\n    out.push(it)\n  }\n  if (boundTaskId && store && typeof store.getTask === 'function') {\n    const task = store.getTask(boundTaskId)\n    for (const it of (task && task.insights) || []) {\n      if (!it || it.archived) continue\n      // 任务级也要挡草稿：reflection 写的是 draft:true，未确认前不该被 query_memory 召回\n      // （project/global 一直有这道闸，任务级漏了）。\n      if (it.draft === true) continue\n      out.push({ ...it, scope: it.scope || 'task' })\n    }\n  }\n  return out\n}\n\n/**\n * 向量融合（可选、默认关闭）：只作用于**经验/洞察层**。\n *\n * 为什么只给这两层：它们的池子小（实测真实 store ≤103 条），融合代价 = 每查询一次编码（~2ms）\n * + 池内点积（可忽略），且向量由调用方按条目缓存一次即可；而 doc/symbol 池是 10⁴ 量级\n * （某真实 TS 仓库 15.6k 条目），同一做法要 60s/查询——所以那一层继续纯词法。\n *\n * 为什么是**融合**而不是\"有向量就只用向量\"：实测（36 条刻意无词重叠的查询 / 103 条池）\n *   · 纯向量替换 BM25：hit@10 53% vs **81%**，明显更差；\n *   · 权重融合在小 k 上更优：k=3 64% vs 58%、k=5 72% vs 67%（α=0.75；α=0.5 时 64%/69%）；\n *   · 并集召回最高（92%）但要返回 ~2k 条，模型可见的内容会翻倍。\n * 所以取 α=0.5：拿到小 k 的收益，又不至于把 BM25 的正确项挤出 top-10。\n *\n * 融合必须在**全量** BM25 序上做（不是先截断再重排），否则\"词法排 20 名但语义很近\"的条目\n * 永远进不来——那正是向量唯一能补的那类。截断到 limit 发生在融合之后。\n *\n * **边界**：`rankEntriesMergedScored` 只返回 **BM25 分 > 0** 的条目，所以本函数只能**重排**，\n * **拉不进**零词重叠的条目——那需要\"并集\"形态（向量 top-k 追加到短名单）。\n *\n * 并集为什么不在这里做（0.6.x 复核过一次，仍不做）：\n *   · 收益是真的：并集 hit@10 92% vs 81%；\n *   · 但它**单独存在时是空操作**：并集候选的词法分是 0，立刻被 `matchedFloor` 挡掉\n *     （matched=0 < min(2,词数)）。要让它们活下来，必须让\"高余弦名次\"**替代**词法闸门——\n *     那就是一个向量闸门，而 auto-inject 里那条路已经量过：绝对余弦在两个方向上都不成立\n *     （合成池上像样、真实交付上 0.42 会剪掉 45/45；换成相对分/名次也只在名次 ≤4 时有\n *     0.46 vs 0.24 的精度差，代价是误杀 4/10 个真命中）。所以并集不是\"再加一段代码\"，\n *     而是\"改准入策略\"——需要先有人工金标准，不能顺手带上。\n *   · 返回条数翻倍的代价反而是次要的（候选可以并集、交付照样截断到 limit）。\n *\n * @param {{item: object, score: number, matched?: number}[]} scored - 已按 BM25 降序\n * @param {string[]} queries\n * @param {{score: (q: string, items: object[]) => Map<string, number>, alpha?: number}} [rerank]\n * @returns {{item: object, score: number, vector?: number}[]}\n */\nfunction fuseVectorHits(scored, queries, rerank) {\n  if (!rerank || typeof rerank.score !== 'function' || !scored.length) return scored\n  const cosOf = new Map()\n  for (const q of queries) {\n    let m = null\n    try { m = rerank.score(q, scored.map((s) => s.item)) } catch { m = null } // 向量层异常不得影响召回\n    if (!(m instanceof Map)) continue\n    for (const [id, v] of m) {\n      if (typeof v !== 'number' || !Number.isFinite(v)) continue\n      if (!cosOf.has(id) || v > cosOf.get(id)) cosOf.set(id, v) // 与多查询的 BM25 合并同语义：取最高\n    }\n  }\n  const alpha = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, typeof rerank.alpha === 'number' ? rerank.alpha : 0.5))\n  const top0 = scored[0].score || 1\n  const rows = scored.map((s) => {\n    const v = cosOf.get(s.item?.insightId) ?? cosOf.get(s.item?.id)\n    return { s, v: typeof v === 'number' && Number.isFinite(v) ? v : undefined }\n  })\n  // 一条都没拿到余弦（查询编码失败 / embed 抛异常 / 向量层返回空 Map）→ **原样返回**。\n  // 与\"整条关掉闸门\"不同：这条路径连归一化都不做，于是 matchedFloor 逐条生效，\n  // 输出与纯词法逐字段一致（这是勘误：旧行为会在这里漏过词法弱命中）。\n  const withVec = rows.filter((r) => r.v !== undefined)\n  if (!withVec.length) return scored\n  // 缺向量分的条目按**这一轮已有余弦的均值**补（不是拿 0 罚它，也不是留一个隐式 0.5）。\n  // 旧写法 `score = rel` 等价于补 α·0.5：真实 store 上 7381 对的余弦中位数只有 0.28、\n  // 查询→标题 top-1 也多在 0.51~0.63，于是\"有低余弦\"的条目会被\"完全没有向量\"的条目压住，\n  // 与注释承诺的\"缺向量不等于不相关\"正好相反。均值是这里假设最少的补法（缺分=平均水平）。\n  const neutral = withVec.reduce((sum, r) => sum + r.v, 0) / withVec.length\n  const fused = rows.map(({ s, v }) => {\n    const rel = s.score / top0\n    return { item: s.item, matched: s.matched, vector: v, score: (1 - alpha) * rel + alpha * (v === undefined ? neutral : v) }\n  })\n  fused.sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score)\n  return fused\n}\n\n/**\n * 按层召回：每层各自 top-k，桶内保留原始分与层内相对分。\n * @param {object} opts\n * @param {object} [opts.store] - ProjectMemoryStore；提供 doc/symbol 池与 IDF 缓存。\n * @param {object} [opts.globalStore] - GlobalStore；提供 global 级 insight。\n * @param {object[]} [opts.entries] - 直接给定检索池（测试/自定义场景），优先于 store。\n * @param {string[]|string} [opts.queries] - 一条或多条查询（LLM 扩展变体也走这里）。\n * @param {string[]} [opts.layers] - 要召回的层；默认四层。\n * @param {number} [opts.limit] - 每层上限。\n * @param {string|null} [opts.boundTaskId] - 当前会话绑定的任务（决定 task 级可见性）。\n * @param {object} [opts.rerank] - 可选向量融合器（**只作用于 experience / insight 层**）。\n *   装了 leanvec 就传，没装就不传 → 行为与纯词法完全一致。见 {@link fuseVectorHits}。\n * @returns {{ layers: object[], flat: object[] }} layers 为分桶结果，flat 为归一化+先验后的跨层提示序。\n */\nexport function recallItems(opts = {}) {\n  const {\n    store = null,\n    globalStore = null,\n    entries = null,\n    queries = [],\n    layers = ['doc', 'symbol', 'experience', 'insight'],\n    limit = 8,\n    boundTaskId = null,\n    rerank = null,\n  } = opts\n  const qs = (Array.isArray(queries) ? queries : [queries]).map((q) => String(q ?? '')).filter(Boolean)\n  // 经验/洞察两层用去掉短拉丁片段的查询（见 `gatedQueryText`）；doc/symbol 层与向量编码仍用原查询。\n  const qsLayers = qs.map(gatedQueryText)\n  const want = new Set(layers)\n  const idf = store && typeof store.getIdfCache === 'function' ?       "content": "// 经验/洞察层的**可选**向量索引（leanvec）：持久化 + 逐条失效 + 优雅降级。\n//\n// 为什么持久化：实测 103 条 × 256 维 = **105 KB**，全量编码要 ~0.4s；读盘 + base64 解码 ~20ms。\n// 为什么只覆盖这两层：它们的池子小（实测真实 store ≤103 条）；doc/symbol 是 10⁴ 量级\n// （某真实 TS 仓库 15.6k 条目），每查询全量编码要 60s，所以那一层继续纯词法。\n//\n// 失效分两级：\n//   ① **模型指纹**（词表内容哈希 + 表字节数）变了 → 整个文件作废，全量重建；\n//   ② **条目文本哈希**变了 → 只重算那一行（其余复用）。\n// 降级：leanvec 不可用、文件损坏、embed 抛异常 —— 一律返回 null / 空 Map，\n// 调用方不传 rerank，行为逐字段退回纯词法。\nimport { createHash } from 'node:crypto'\nimport { existsSync, readFileSync, statSync } from 'node:fs'\nimport { dirname, join } from 'node:path'\nimport { pathToFileURL } from 'node:url'\nimport { writeJsonAtomic } from './util/fs.js'\n\nconst FILE = 'vectors.json'\nconst VERSION = 1\nconst DIM = 256\n\n/**\n * 条目用于编码的文本：**只取标题**（经验条目取 problem）。\n *\n * 为什么不用完整的评分文本：实测（36 条刻意无词重叠的查询 / 103 条池）标题变体的并集\n * hit@10 是 94%，而把 300 字摘要一起喂进去只有 89%——长文本在均值池化下会被稀释向语料均值。\n *\n * ⚠ 兜底链必须与 `normalizeInsight` 的标题推导**逐项相同**（含 `choice` 与否决 `topic`），\n * 且同样截到 200：写入路径拿的是**归一化之前**的 raw（`save_lesson` 允许只给\n * pattern / choice），只认 title 会让这类写入的查询文本变成空串 → 整条向量带去重静默失效\n * （`vectorNear` 见空文本直接返回 null）。索引侧编码的是落盘后的 title，两边同源才可比。\n */\nexport function vectorText(it) {\n  const t = it?.title || it?.pattern || it?.problem || it?.choice || it?.topic || it?.body\n  return String(t ?? '').trim().slice(0, 200)\n}\n\nconst hashOf = (text) => createHash('sha256').update(String(text)).digest('hex').slice(0, 16)\nconst keyOf = (it) => (it?.insightId ?? it?.id ?? null)\n\n/**\n * leanvec 的模型指纹：词表内容 sha256 + 向量表字节数。\n *\n * 词表决定 token id、向量表按同一 id 排布，任一变化都必须让旧向量作废。\n * 表全文哈希要 ~0.2s，与省下的 0.4s 相抵，所以用\"内容哈希 + 字节数\"近似——\n * 只有\"表内容变了但字节数恰好相同且词表没变\"这种极罕见情形会漏判，日后再加密实指纹。\n * @returns {string|null} null = 这个目录不是一份可用的 leanvec\n */\nexport function leanvecFingerprint(modelDir) {\n  if (!modelDir) return null\n  const tj = join(modelDir, 'dist', 'leanvec.tokenizer.json')\n  const tb = join(modelDir, 'dist', 'leanvec.f32')\n  if (!existsSync(tj) || !existsSync(tb)) return null\n  const h = createHash('sha256').update(readFileSync(tj)).digest('hex').slice(0, 16)\n  return `l1:${h}:${statSync(tb).size}`\n}\n\n/** 从磁盘读回旧索引；任何异常都当成\"没有\"，绝不抛。 */\nfunction readSaved(file) {\n  try {\n    const doc = JSON.parse(readFileSync(file, 'utf8'))\n    if (doc?.version !== VERSION || typeof doc.blob !== 'string' || !Array.isArray(doc.ids) || !Array.isArray(doc.hashes)) return null\n    const buf = Buffer.from(doc.blob, 'base64')\n    // 复制一次拿到 byteOffset=0 且对齐的新缓冲——Buffer.from(base64) 的下层 ArrayBuffer\n    // 可能不是 4 字节对齐，直接 new Float32Array(buf.buffer, buf.byteOffset) 会抛。\n    const u8 = new Uint8Array(buf)\n    const all = new Float32Array(u8.buffer, 0, Math.floor(u8.byteLength / 4))\n    const map = new Map()\n    for (let i = 0; i < doc.ids.length; i++) {\n      const off = i * DIM\n      if (off + DIM > all.length) break\n      map.set(doc.ids[i], { v: all.subarray(off, off + DIM), h: String(doc.hashes[i] ?? '') })\n    }\n    return { model: doc.model, dim: doc.dim, map, all }\n  } catch {\n    return null\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n * 打开（或新建）向量索引。\n * @param {object} o\n * @param {string|null} o.dir - 持久化目录（通常是项目 store 目录）；null → 只在内存里\n * @param {object[]} o.items - 要建索引的条目（经验 + 洞察两层合一份，id 互不冲突）\n * @param {(text: string) => Float32Array|null} o.embed - leanvec 的编码函数\n * @param {string} o.model - 模型指纹（见 {@link leanvecFingerprint}）\n * @returns {{score: Function, flush: Function, stats: object}|null} null = 不可用 → 调用方退回纯词法\n */\nexport function openVectorIndex({ dir = null, items = [], embed, model, dim = DIM } = {}) {\n  if (typeof embed !== 'function' || !model || dim !== DIM) return null\n  const file = dir ? join(dir, FILE) : null\n  const saved = file ? readSaved(file) : null\n  const usable = saved && saved.model === model && saved.dim === dim ? saved : null\n  const entryMap = new Map() // key -> { v: Float32Array, h: string }\n  let reused = 0\n  let computed = 0\n  let dirty = false\n  /**\n   * 本进程内被删掉的 id：`forget()` 之后即使调用方还拿着旧的条目列表，也不能把它重新编码\n   * 写回去（长驻进程里 store 对象可能仍持有已删条目的引用；\"删了又活过来\"比不删更难排查）。\n   */\n  const dropped = new Set()\n\n  const ensure = (it) => {\n    const key = keyOf(it)\n    if (!key || dropped.has(key)) return null\n    const text = vectorText(it)\n    if (!text) return null\n    const h = hashOf(text)\n    const prev = usable?.map.get(key)\n    if (prev && prev.h === h) {\n      if (!entryMap.has(key)) { entryMap.set(key, prev); reused++ }\n      return prev.v\n    }\n    if (entryMap.has(key) && entryMap.get(key).h === h) return entryMap.get(key).v\n    let v = null\n    try { v = embed(text) } catch { v = null }\n    if (!v) return null\n    entryMap.set(key, { v, h })\n    computed++\n    dirty = true\n    return v\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 持久化（仅在有变化时写；失败不影响本次运行）。\n   * ⚠ **不建目录**：这是缓存写入，`score()` 会在读路径上调它，`writeJsonAtomic` 的\n   * `mkdirSync(recursive)` 会在\"传错 root\"时于任意可写位置造出 `<root>/.dsh-project-memory`\n   * ——那正是 query_memory / memory_stats 不得不加\"根存在性\"护栏的原因。目录在写入侧\n   * 早就存在（条目的来源），所以这条只会挡住\"从零造目录\"。\n   */\n  const flush = () => {\n    if (!dirty || !file) return false\n    try {\n      if (!existsSync(dirname(file))) return false\n      const keys = [...entryMap.keys()]\n      const all = new Float32Array(keys.length * dim)\n      const hashes = []\n      keys.forEach((k, i) => { all.set(entryMap.get(k).v, i * dim); hashes.push(entryMap.get(k).h) })\n      writeJsonAtomic(file, {\n        version: VERSION, model, dim, ids: keys, hashes,\n        blob: Buffer.from(all.buffer, all.byteOffset, all.byteLength).toString('base64'),\n      })\n      dirty = false\n      return true\n    } catch {\n      return false // 磁盘不可写等：本次仍可用，只是下次还要重算\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 从索引里移除若干行（`forget` 之后调用）。**不需要加载模型**，也立即落盘：\n   * 删除承诺是\"真删\"，而向量行是标题的 256 维均值池化——留着就不是真删。\n   * @param {string[]} ids\n   * @returns {number} 实际移除的行数\n   */\n  const forget = (ids) => {\n    let n = 0\n    for (const id of ids || []) {\n      if (!id) continue\n      // 两处都要删：`usable` 是打开时读回来的快照，`ensure()` 会从它那里复用旧行 ——\n      // 只删 entryMap 的话，下一次 score 会把被删的那一行原样复活。\n      let hit = false\n      if (usable?.map?.delete(id)) hit = true\n      if (entryMap.delete(id)) hit = true\n      if (hit) { n++; dirty = true; dropped.add(id) }\n    }\n    if (n) flush()\n    return n\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * 与 auto-inject / recall 两个接缝约定的同一签名：返回 Map<id, cos>。\n   * 查询无法编码、或某条目无文本/无向量 → 该条不进 Map（调用方据此降级，不当 0 分罚它）。\n   * 同时用 `insightId` 与 `id` 两个键登记，兼容两层各自的 id 约定。\n   */  const score = (q, cands) => {\n    const out = new Map()\n    let qv = null\n    try { qv = embed(typeof q === 'string' ? q : String(q ?? '')) } catch { qv = null }\n    if (!qv) return out\n    for (const it of cands || []) {\n      const v = ensure(it)\n      if (!v) continue\n      let s = 0\n      for (let i = 0; i < dim; i++) s += qv[i] * v[i]\n      const key = keyOf(it)\n      out.set(key, s)\n      if (it?.id && it.id !== key) out.set(it.id, s)\n    }\n    flush()\n    return out\n  }\n\n  // 首次打开时把给定条目全部对齐（复用旧行 / 补算缺失行），并**立即落盘**——\n  // 那 0.4s 的构建成本必须在本次会话就存下来，而不是等第一次查询才写。\n  // （必须放在 flush 定义之后：flush 是 const 箭头函数，提前调用会 TDZ。）\n  for (const it of items) ensure(it)\n  flush()\n\n  return {\n    score,\n    flush,\n    forget,\n    stats: {\n      file, model, dim,\n      persisted: entryMap.size,\n      reusedFirstOpen: reused,\n      computedFirstOpen: computed,\n      loadedFromDisk: Boolean(usable),\n    },\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n * 从两个 store 收集**要建索引的条目**：洞察层（项目 + 全局）。\n * 与提示通道/召回看到的池子同源；归档条目不进（它们不会被召回）。\n * v0.4 的经验笔记也在里面——统一存储后它们是 `kind:'experience'` 的 insight，\n * 加载时已从 experience.json 导入，不再有第二个池子。\n */\nexport function vectorItemsFrom(store, globalStore) {\n  const out = []\n  try { if (typeof store?.insightItems === 'function') out.push(...store.insightItems()) } catch { /* store 形状不保证 */ }\n  try { if (typeof globalStore?.items === 'function') out.push(...globalStore.items()) } catch { /* 同上 */ }\n  return out.filter((it) => it && !it.archived)\n}\n\n/** leanvec 运行时只在进程内加载一次（77 MB 表 + 词表索引 Map，加载 ~90ms、常驻 ~120MB）。 */\nlet runtimeCache = null\n/** 向量索引按 (storeDir, 模型指纹) 缓存；条目增删改由 `score()` 里的逐条对齐懒处理。 */\nconst indexCache = new Map()\n/**\n * \"解析目录 + 模型指纹\"的进程内记忆。\n *\n * 为什么必须缓存：`leanvecFingerprint()` 要 sha256 一份 1.94MB 的词表（~10ms），而\n * `createVectorRerank` 在**每一步注入**上都会被调用——不缓存就是每步白付 10ms。\n * 键取\"显式配置 + 环境变量\"的组合：两者都没变就不必重算。\n */\nconst resolveCache = new Map()\n\n/**\n * 解析 leanvec 目录。顺序：显式配置 > 环境变量 `DSH_LEANVEC_DIR` > **作为可选依赖**。\n * 三者都拿不到 → null（调用方退回纯词法，这是正常路径不是错误）。\n */\nasync function resolveLeanvecDir(explicit) {\n  const cand = []\n  if (typeof explicit === 'string' && explicit) cand.push(explicit)\n  if (typeof process.env.DSH_LEANVEC_DIR === 'string' && process.env.DSH_LEANVEC_DIR) cand.push(process.env.DSH_LEANVEC_DIR)\n  try {\n    const { createRequire } = await import('node:module')\n    const req = createRequire(import.meta.url)\n    try { cand.push(dirname(req.resolve('leanvec/package.json'))) } catch { cand.push(dirname(dirname(req.resolve('leanvec')))) }\n  } catch {\n    // 未安装 leanvec：**正常**，不是故障——可选依赖的意义就在这里\n  }\n  for (const d of cand) if (leanvecFingerprint(d)) return d\n  return null\n}\n\n/**\n * 解析当前可用的 leanvec 目录（**不加载模型**，只做 memo 过的解析 + 指纹）。\n * 给 `memory_stats` 这类\"只想知道开没开\"的调用方用。\n * @param {string|null} [vectorDir]\n * @returns {Promise<{dir: string|null, fingerprint: string|null}>}\n */\nexport async function resolveVectorLayer(vectorDir = null) {\n  const rk = `${typeof vectorDir === 'string' ? vectorDir : ''}\\u0000${process.env.DSH_LEANVEC_DIR ?? ''}`\n  let resolved = resolveCache.get(rk)\n  if (resolved === undefined) {\n    const dir = await resolveLeanvecDir(vectorDir)\n    resolved = { dir, fingerprint: dir ? leanvecFingerprint(dir) : null }\n    resolveCache.set(rk, resolved) // 未安装也记下来：避免每步重复 resolve 的 IO\n  }\n  return resolved\n}\n\n/**\n * 解析目录 + 加载运行时 + 打开（或复用）索引。**不含 alpha**——重排与写入侧去重\n * 共用这一层，`alpha` 只属于前者（它是个排序权重，不该控制去重是否工作）。\n * @returns {Promise<{index: object, fingerprint: string, dir: string}|null>}\n */\nasync function openEngine({ storeDir = null, items = [], vectorDir = null } = {}) {\n  const { dir, fingerprint } = await resolveVectorLayer(vectorDir)\n  if (!dir || !fingerprint) return null\n  try {\n    // 运行时按「目录 + 模型指纹」缓存：同一目录换了模型文件时必须重新加载，\n    // 否则会用旧模型编码、却把新指纹写进 vectors.json。\n    if (!runtimeCache || runtimeCache.dir !== dir || runtimeCache.fingerprint !== fingerprint) {\n      const mod = await import(pathToFileURL(join(dir, 'src', 'embed.mjs')).href)\n      const lv = mod.loadLeanvec({\n        table: join(dir, 'dist', 'leanvec.f32'),\n        tokenizer: join(dir, 'dist', 'leanvec.tokenizer.json'),\n      })\n      runtimeCache = { dir, lv, fingerprint }\n    }\n    const { lv } = runtimeCache\n    const ck = `${storeDir ?? ''}\\u0000${fingerprint}`\n    // 索引按 (storeDir, 指纹) 缓存；之后新增/改写的条目由 `score()` 里的逐条对齐懒处理\n    // （内容变了就重算那一行并落盘），所以这里不需要按 items 签名判断是否重建。\n    let index = indexCache.get(ck)\n    if (!index) {\n      index = openVectorIndex({ dir: storeDir, items, embed: (t) => lv.embed(t), model: fingerprint })\n      if (!index) return null\n      indexCache.set(ck, index)\n    }\n    return { index, fingerprint, dir }\n  } catch {\n    return null // 任何异常都降级到纯词法，绝不因为可选的向量层让召回失败\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n * 构造给 `recallItems` / `buildInjection` 用的 rerank。leanvec 不可用 → **null**。\n *\n * 装了就有向量、没装就纯词法，两条路的差别只在排序：闸门（覆盖率/共同词数）与返回条数都不变。\n * @param {object} o\n * @param {string|null} [o.storeDir] - 持久化位置（通常是项目 store 目录）；null → 只在内存里\n * @param {object[]} [o.items] - 建索引的条目（见 {@link vectorItemsFrom}）\n * @param {string|null} [o.vectorDir] - leanvec 目录（显式配置优先）\n * @param {number} [o.alpha] - 融合权重；实测 0.5 在小 k 上最优（见 recall.js 的注释）\n * @param {number} [o.itemMin] - 条目的余弦下限（**实验性**，不设则不过滤；见 auto-inject 注释）\n * @param {number} [o.speakMin] - 通道级语义救援阈值（**实验性**，不设则不启用）\n * @returns {Promise<{score: Function, alpha: number, itemMin?: number, speakMin?: number, stats: object}|null>}\n */\nexport async function createVectorRerank({ storeDir = null, items = [], vectorDir = null, alpha = 0.5, itemMin, speakMin } = {}) {\n  // 强制关闭：`vectorDir: 'off'`（或 alpha=0）一律返回 null，连模型都不加载。\n  // 为什么需要：装了可选依赖之后，没有这个开关就无法退回纯词法——测试固定基线、\n  // 线上排查\"是不是向量层导致的\"都会用得上。\n  if (typeof vectorDir === 'string' && vectorDir.trim().toLowerCase() === 'off') return null\n  if (alpha === 0) return null\n  const eng = await openEngine({ storeDir, items, vectorDir })\n  if (!eng) return null\n  const a = typeof alpha === 'number' && alpha >= 0 && alpha <= 1 ? alpha : 0.5\n  // `itemMin` / `speakMin` 只有**显式配置**时才进返回值：没有可发布的默认值（见 auto-inject\n  // 的证据），不设即整段逻辑不执行，默认路径与旧版逐字段一致。\n  const out = { score: eng.index.score, alpha: a, stats: eng.index.stats }\n  if (typeof itemMin === 'number' && Number.isFinite(itemMin)) out.itemMin = itemMin\n  if (typeof speakMin === 'number' && Number.isFinite(speakMin)) out.speakMin = speakMin\n  return out\n}\n\n/**\n * 写入侧（近重复检测）用的余弦打分器。leanvec 不可用 / 显式关掉 → **null**。\n *\n * 与 `createVectorRerank` **刻意分开**：`autoContext.vectorAlpha` 是排序权重，把它设成 0\n * 是\"关掉重排\"，不该连带关掉写入去重（旧实现复用同一个函数，于是 `vectorAlpha: 0` 静默\n * 停掉了 0.9 自动覆盖 / 0.7 近邻提示）。开关是独立的 `vectorDedup`。\n * @returns {Promise<((text: string, items: object[]) => Map<string, number>)|null>}\n */\nexport async function createVectorCosine({ storeDir = null, items = [], vectorDir = null, dedup = true } = {}) {\n  if (dedup === false) return null\n  if (typeof vectorDir === 'string' && vectorDir.trim().toLowerCase() === 'off') return null\n  const eng = await openEngine({ storeDir, items, vectorDir })\n  if (!eng) return null\n  return (text, cands) => eng.index.score(text, cands)\n}\n\n/**\n * 删除若干条目的向量行（`forget` 之后调用）。**不加载模型**：只读文件、过滤 id、原子重写，\n * 并同步清掉进程内缓存索引里的同名行（否则下次 flush 会把它写回去）。\n * @param {{dir: string|null, ids: string[]}} o\n * @returns {number} 移除的行数（尽力而为，绝不抛）\n */\nexport function forgetVectorRows({ dir = null, ids = [] } = {}) {\n  const want = new Set((ids || []).filter(Boolean))\n  if (!dir || !want.size) return 0\n  let n = 0\n  // ① 进程内缓存：按 storeDir 前缀找对应的索引（一个 store 一般只有一份）\n  for (const [ck, idx] of indexCache) {\n    if (!ck.startsWith(`${dir}\\u0000`)) continue\n    if (idx && typeof idx.forget === 'function') n += idx.forget([...want])\n  }\n  // ② 磁盘：文件可能是别的进程写的，单独再清一遍（幂等）\n  const file = join(dir, FILE)\n  try {\n    if (!existsSync(file)) return n\n    const doc = JSON.parse(readFileSync(file, 'utf8'))\n    if (!doc || !Array.isArray(doc.ids) || typeof doc.blob !== 'string') return n\n    const keep = []\n    for (let i = 0; i < doc.ids.length; i++) if (!want.has(doc.ids[i])) keep.push(i)\n    if (keep.length === doc.ids.length) return n\n    const buf = Buffer.from(doc.blob, 'base64')\n    const u8 = new Uint8Array(buf)\n    const stride = Number.isInteger(doc.dim) && doc.dim > 0 ? doc.dim : DIM\n    const all = new Float32Array(u8.buffer, 0, Math.floor(u8.byteLength / 4))\n    const next = new Float32Array(keep.length * stride)\n    keep.forEach((src, i) => next.set(all.subarray(src * stride, src * stride + stride), i * stride))\n    writeJsonAtomic(file, {\n      ...doc,\n      ids: keep.map((i) => doc.ids[i]),\n      hashes: keep.map((i) => doc.hashes?.[i] ?? ''),\n      blob: Buffer.from(next.buffer, next.byteOffset, next.byteLength).toString('base64'),\n    })\n    n = Math.max(n, doc.ids.length - keep.length)\n  } catch {\n    // 损坏/不可写：删除承诺只对条目本身负责，向量缓存坏掉会在下次重建\n  }\n  return n\n}\n\n/**\n * 索引状态摘要（**不加载模型**）：给 `memory_stats` 用的可观测量。\n * 报告行数、陈旧行（文件里有、store 里已没有）、体积、模型指纹与落盘时间。\n */\nexport function vectorIndexSummary({ dir = null, items = [] } = {}) {\n  const live = new Set((items || []).map((it) => (it?.insightId ?? it?.id)).filter(Boolean))\n  const summary = { file: dir ? join(dir, FILE) : null, rows: 0, live: live.size, stale: 0, bytes: 0, updatedAt: null, model: null }\n  if (!dir) return summary\n  try {\n    const st = statSync(summary.file)\n    summary.bytes = st.size\n    summary.updatedAt = st.mtime.toISOString()\n    const doc = JSON.parse(readFileSync(summary.file, 'utf8'))\n    summary.model = typeof doc?.model === 'string' ? doc.model : null\n    for (const id of Array.isArray(doc?.ids) ? doc.ids : []) {\n      summary.rows++\n      if (!live.has(id)) summary.stale++\n    }\n  } catch {\n    // 没有/坏了：rows=0，上层据此说\"尚未建立\"\n  }\n  return summary\n}\n"

      "content": "# dsh-project-memory\n\n> 如果这个插件帮你省下 1 小时 Debug 时间，请点个 Star。\n\n[English](README.md) | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)\n\n[![ci](https://github.com/00080000/dsh-project-memory/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/00080000/dsh-project-memory/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE) [![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@yolk_vat-y/dsh-project-memory)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@yolk_vat-y/dsh-project-memory) [![npm downloads](https://img.shields.io/npm/dm/%40yolk_vat-y%2Fdsh-project-memory?style=flat-square&color=orange)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@yolk_vat-y/dsh-project-memory) [![Listed on dsh-plugin.org](https://dsh-plugin.org/badges/listed.svg)](https://dsh-plugin.org/plugins/00080000/dsh-project-memory) [![Awesome](https://awesome-dsh-plugin.com/badge.svg)](https://awesome-dsh-plugin.com)\n\n为 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)（dsh）agent 提供持久化的 **项目开发记忆**。专门针对项目开发，原生融合 dsh 任务系统，会话内任务清单与读过的文件自动沉淀为跨会话任务记录，任务↔文件自动关联——开发工作流可切换、可续接，无需重复梳理整个项目，解决上下文失效；文档（PDF/Markdown/txt）与代码符号写入工作区独立存储，文档自动交叉链接至所提及的代码符号；经验笔记（问题 → 方案）自动去重，避免重复踩坑。所有数据按项目落盘，跨会话压缩与交接保留，召回附带 `路径:行号` 可回源核实。无原生构建、无向量数据库。79 MB 的本地嵌入表 `leanvec` 随安装默认启用；它不在时自动退回纯词法。\n\n\n> 插件在磁盘上维护一份精简的项目**记忆**，每条记录指向具体的文件与行号；agent 需要快速了解项目时先查**记忆**，无需重读整个项目。\n![任务面板：任务清单、步骤进度与涉及文件](docs/images/image.png)\n\n## 特性\n\n- **TaskBridge：跨会话开发任务** — 会话内的任务清单与触碰过的文件持久化为项目任务实体，工作流可以随时切走再续接，不必重新界定项目范围。关联文件按最近活跃排序（读取永远不越过写过的文件），续接时一眼看到该先看哪些。新会话通过 `list_tasks` → `select_task` 续接。委派给子代理的工作不会建档。旧宿主下降级为纯记录。\n- **任务面板与编辑** — 卡片可拖拽，展示任务步骤与涉及文件，可折叠为迷你条或彻底隐藏；标题、步骤与状态支持行内编辑，与模型更新走同一条写回路径；四档外观风格只改材质、几何、字型与密度，颜色跟随宿主。面板默认隐藏，仅在显式唤起后出现；会话切换只后台同步，刷新页面不会自行打开；渲染错误有边界兜底，面板崩溃不会拖垮宿主。\n- **文档记忆** — PDF、Markdown 与纯文本按块切分并生成摘要，索引期不调用模型。每条保留一段简短摘要供注入、一个有界的检索词集合，以及回源引用。\n- **代码符号记忆** — 零依赖扫描器提取函数、类、方法、接口与类型别名及其完整签名，覆盖 8 种语言。项目装了 `typescript` 时，可选第二层补推导返回类型、泛型与接口，后台执行、不阻塞索引。\n- **读到即记忆、变更即刷新** — 文件在模型实际读取的瞬间被记忆，记忆是正常工作的副产品，而不是额外的一次全量扫描；从未读过的文件不会被记忆。后台轮询只重记变更过的文件。\n- **文档 ↔ 代码交叉链接** — 文档提及的符号，在查询该符号时一并带出。链接按**当前**符号表解算，不会过期。\n- **混合召回** — 对文档、符号、经验笔记与 insight 排序召回，可选 LLM 查询扩展。`leanvec` 是 optionalDependency：默认装上并按余弦重排经验/洞察两层，没装或 `vectorDir: 'off'` 则退回纯词法。针对 CJK 增强：短语加分、同义词表，以及文档↔符号链接的词边界处理。\n- **经验笔记** — 记录问题 → 方案；相似问题覆盖而不重复，数量随项目规模有界，与教训走同一条注入通道：检索与自动注入都能带出。\n- **分层 insight 记忆（教训 / 决策 / 流程）** — 同一实体贯穿任务、项目、全局三级。近重复合并或强化；提升是更换归属而非复制。被使用会记账，因此衰减与容量按活跃度排序，而不是只按时间。面板提供分级的记忆视图用于审核与编辑；列表按新→旧排列并增量加载——每页 30 条，滚到底前就预取下一页，离屏行不参与渲染，记忆变多也不卡。\n- **触发式注入** — insight 可携带 authored trigger：只有 `when` 能触发，`guard` 只能收窄，`prevents` 记下没有它会坏在哪。语料正文永远不能触发注入；统计通道另有独立门槛，默认沉默。\n\n## 安装\n\n插件只依赖通过 peerDependencies 声明的稳定公共 API。\n\n```bash\ncd dsh-project-memory && dsh plugin --profile web add . -w\n```\n\n`-w`（workspace-root）标志是必需的：profile 目录是 pnpm 工作区根目录，不带该标志 pnpm 会拒绝 add。其他目录下用同样的命令加上绝对路径即可。\n\n插件同时发布在 npm 上（scoped 包）：\n\n```bash\ndsh plugin --profile web add @yolk_vat-y/dsh-project-memory -w\n```\n\n每个被索引的项目在 `<root>/.dsh-project-memory/` 下有独立存储；它默认就把自己排除在 git 之外，`.gitignore` 无需任何添加。\n\n## 用法\n\n以下工具由 **agent 自动调用**，无需用户手动输入。在对话中直接说自然语言即可——例如「给这个项目建个索引」或「auth 模块是干嘛的」，或者正常开发即可——agent 会自动调用对应工具。默认开启「读到即索引」：模型读哪个文件，就顺便索引哪个文件，记忆在你干活的过程中自然积累。`watch_repo` 让显式监听的根目录在后台保持新鲜；`index_repo` 强制对项目做一次全量回填（未变更文件自动跳过）。\n\n在 git 工作树里，语料就是 `git ls-files --cached --others --exclude-standard` 的清单——已跟踪文件，加上未被忽略的未跟踪文件——因此 `.gitignore`（含嵌套规则）决定什么会被记忆。不是 git 工作树的目录退回普通遍历（不套忽略规则）。「读到即索引」对单个文件套用同一判据；显式 `index_doc` 则总是索引你指定的文件。\n\n| 工具 | 用途 |\n|---|---|\n| `index_doc file_path` | 索引单个文档（PDF/MD/txt）：分块、确定性摘要，带 `路径:行号` 入库。未变更文件自动跳过。 |\n| `index_repo root` | 索引整个项目：文档生成确定性摘要，代码文件生成零 token 符号表。增量更新，store 跟随文件清单：已删除、被忽略或移走的文件会被清理；文档与符号交叉链接。根目录不存在或在排除名单上时，会在写入任何内容前拒绝。 |\n| `watch_repo root` | 启用自动刷新：后台轮询检测新增/变更文件，仅重抽这些文件。监听的项目在插件重启后自动恢复；不存在或在排除名单上的根目录会被拒绝，已消失的根目录会被丢弃而不是被重新创建。 |\n| `memory_stats root` | 查看记忆库内容：总量、最近索引时间，以及按时间排序的逐文件清单。 |\n| `query_memory query` | 对文档、符号、经验与 insight 执行排序检索，可选 LLM 查询扩展。`type` 选择层（`all` / `doc` / `symbol` / `experience` / `insight` / `task`）。返回带相对分数、引用或 insight id、以及文档→符号链接的结果。 |\n| `list_tasks` | 列出本项目任务记录（含归档，带标记）。新会话/续接前先调用。 |\n| `select_task` | 将会话绑定到某任务（此后 todo 清单与读文件同步进该任务）。按 `taskId` 精确绑定，或按 `title` 完全匹配（多个同名返回候选；无则新建）。带 title 可改名；自动解归档。 |\n| `archive_task` | 归档任务（隐藏默认视图、不占容量、停止同步）。`select_task` 可恢复。 |\n| `show_task_panel` | 在 UI 中打开任务面板。用户要求查看任务列表或你想展示面板时调用。 |\n| `/tasks`（用户输入，不经模型） | 唯一的用户命令：展示任务栈并驱动工作流卡片。其余动作是它的**子动词**，由卡片按钮调用：`switch` / `archive` / `unbind` / `rename` / `todos …` / `step` / `step-move` / `step-text` 为任务动作，`insight list [scope] [offset] [limit]` / `confirm` / `promote` / `demote` / `archive` / `restore` / `delete` / `save` / `edit` 为记忆动作。 |\n| `remember problem solution` | 保存经验笔记。它就是 `kind: 'experience'` 的 insight——与教训 / 决策 / 流程同库、同去重、同删除入口。相似问题合并或覆盖而非重复。 |\n| `forget id_or_query` | 删除记忆——教训 / 决策 / 流程与经验笔记一视同仁，task / project / global 全层一次搞定，不必先知道它在哪一层。精确 id 删那一条；关键词按**查询侧覆盖率**匹配（命中词 ÷ 查询词数）。真删、无撤销；关键词命中超过上限（默认 10）时**一条都不删**，只列出候选。最近删除的 **5 条**会以完整条目留在该层 store 同目录的 `deleted.json`（项目层 `<root>/.dsh-project-memory/deleted.json`，global 层在 global 文件旁），删除回报里给出真实路径——删错时读它、重新保存一次即可找回。 |\n| `save_lesson` | 在 task/project/global 任一作用域保存教训 / 决策 / 流程；带 `id` 就是**就地覆盖**既有条目（只改本次显式传的字段，旧值留在 `prev`，用同一个 id 再写一次即可写回）。写入前与既有记忆比对：余弦 ≥ 0.9 自动覆盖那一条，≥ 0.7 在返回里提示近邻 id；`leanvec` 不在时退回词法 overlap ≥ 0.7 合并、0.65–0.7 强化。同一 insight 被 2+ 任务命中自动 task→project、3+ → global。主要参数：`id`、`title`、`kind`、`scope`、正文（`pattern`/`fix`、`choice`/`reason` 或 `steps`）、`trigger`（`when` 是唯一触发面，`guard` 只能收窄，`prevents` 记下没有它会坏在哪）。 |\n\n`/tasks` 在 web 的 `/` 菜单里以带图标的**「工作流」**组呈现 —— 三个视图入口：任务 / 项目记忆 / 全局记忆（标题随界面语言切换）。它是插件唯一注册的命令，其余动作全部作为它的子动词由卡片按钮驱动。\n\n## 工作原理\n\n设计遵循四个原则：\n\n- **易失性** — 上下文是临时的，会话压缩即丢失。\n- **持久性** — **记忆**存于磁盘，跨压缩与会话保留。\n- **紧凑性** — 代码层每个符号只存一行有界声明，文档层每个 chunk 保留 ≤300 字符的摘要与有界词项。**派生数据一律不落盘**：doc→symbol 链接在读取期计算。最终体积取决于符号密度与 chunk 长度，下面是特定语料的实测值（2026-10-13），不是承诺：纯代码的前端应用（289 文件）实测 **325 bytes/条目 ≈ 源码 21%**；符号密集的 TypeScript monorepo（12,634 文件 / 代码 107 MB + 文档 14 MB）实测代码层 **占源码 22%**（整库 549 bytes/条目）、文档层 **占其源码 127%**；文档占比高的语料单条目最大，一个文档为主的工作区（Markdown + PDF）实测 **1,401 bytes/条目**。\n- **可核验性** — **召回**在适用时携带 `路径:行号` 引用，agent 可对照源文件核实。\n\n构建**记忆**无需预先全量扫描：文件在模型读取时被记忆，**记忆**恰好覆盖实际处理过的内容。未变更的文件重读是空操作，因此持续维护开销很低。\n\n存储按项目独立存放，并跟随代码库变化：文件变更按内容哈希重新抽取，文件删除则同步移除。经验笔记是 `insights.json` 里 `kind: 'experience'` 的条目，仅检索、累积不影响上下文。\n\n## 设计\n\n```\n.dsh-project-memory/\n  format.json      布局标记（v2，分片式）\n  shards/          每个被索引源文件一个自描述 JSON —— 写入只落脏分片\n  watch.json       被监听根目录\n  tasks.json       TaskBridge 任务实体（跨会话）\n  binding.json     当前会话 ↔ 任务绑定\n  insights.json    项目级记忆（教训 / 决策 / 流程 / 经验笔记）——唯一实体\n  vectors.json     可选语义索引（只在向量层启用时存在）\n  injection-audit.jsonl   每次真实注入一行（注入了什么 / 为什么 / 丢了什么 / 额度）\n  admission-shadow.jsonl  每步一行，全部被评分的候选 + 特征（离线重放）\n```\n\n- **增量** — 按文件内容哈希，仅重新抽取变更文件。\n- **交叉链接** — `query_memory` 返回文档 chunk 时，按**当前**符号表解算它提到的符号，以 `references` 带出。文档先索引、符号后到也能链上。\n- **查询扩展** — `llmQueryExpansion` 开启时，把查询改写为多个变体（同义词、中英、符号名猜测）再合并分数；关闭时查询完全不碰 LLM。索引本身不调用模型。\n- **一致性** — 事实层跟随代码库（哈希重抽 / 删除即移除）；经验层仅检索，配合覆盖与 `forget` 机制。写入在跨进程的目录锁（`.write.lock`）内做一次短暂的读改写，因此两个 dsh 实例可以共用一个项目存储：分片按 `indexedAt` 收敛，拿不到锁的那次保存会延后重试。\n\n## 架构（任务面板）\n\n```\nTaskPanel (Container)\n├── task-data-store  (服务端数据，跨标签页 BroadcastChannel 同步)\n├── task-ui-store    (本地 UI 状态，localStorage)\n├── task-hooks       (useTaskDrag, useTaskEdit)\n└── TaskComponents   (MiniBar, TaskCard — 纯展示组件)\n```\n\n工作流卡片可收起，自动适应 dsh 及主题插件风格，提供四种卡片风格切换。\n\n![四种卡片风格](docs/images/image-4.png)\n\n## 配置\n\n| 键 | 默认值 | 含义 |\n|---|---|---|\n| `memoryDir` | `.dsh-project-memory` | 每个被索引根目录内的存储目录 |\n| `chunkChars` / `maxChunksPerFile` | 3000 / 40 | 每个文档块最大字符数、每文档最大块数 |\n| `maxFileSizeMb` | 10 | 大于该值（MB）的文档（含 PDF）/代码文件跳过；峰值系数见下文「单文件内存预算」 |\n| `maxPdfPages` | 1000 | PDF 页数上限 |\n| `maxOutputChars` | 8000 | `query_memory` 返回文本上限（字符） |\n| `lazyIndexing` | true | 模型读取文件的瞬间即索引 |\n| `autoIndexOnFirstUse` | false | 插件加载时对当前工作目录做全量扫描（可选） |\n| `watch` / `watchInterval` | true / 30 | 后台刷新；基础轮询间隔（秒）；回合进行中静默（5 分钟兜底，外部改动仍会自愈），回合结束立刻合并扫一次；空闲时逐步退避到最长 2 分钟，一有变化立即回到该值 |\n| `maxScanFiles` / `maxScanDepth` | 20000 / 12 | 单次扫描的文件数与目录深度硬上限；被截断时会在报告里说明，且不会删除没扫到的条目。**无法取消**：`0` 或任何非法值都回落到默认值 |\n| `allowUnsafeRoots` | false | 允许**显式**工具调用指向排除名单上的目录。懒索引、会话审计与 TaskBridge 始终不越权；`autoIndexOnFirstUse` 不在此列——它同样被这个开关放行 |\n| `llmQueryExpansion` / `expansionCount` | false / 6 | 检索前用 LLM 扩展查询（默认关闭，节省 token）；扩展变体上限 |\n| `tsPath` / `enableTypeScript` | (自动) / true | 可选：强制指定 `typescript` 安装路径；`enableTypeScript: false` 彻底禁用类型感知层 |\n| `tasklist.enabled` / `tasklist.syncHostOnAdopt` | true / true | TaskBridge 自动同步（由会话 todo 清单与文件读取沉淀任务实体）；绑定任务时把其步骤推给宿主任务清单，使 dsh 镜像该任务 |\n| `insight.*` | dedupOverlap `0.7` ·
