Pass root explicitly to place the memory store.'\n          )\n        }\n      }\n      const memoryDir = memoryRootFor(root, config.memoryDir)\n\n      const store = new ProjectMemoryStore(memoryDir).load()\n\n      const rel = storeKey(path.relative(root, filePath).split(path.sep).join('/'))\n      const { hash, size } = await sha256OfFile(filePath)\n      const existing = store.fileRecord(rel)\n      // 与 index_repo/watch/lazy 同一条判据：哈希未变但旧条目缺 terms 时仍要重抽一次（一次性回填）。\n      // 少了这一步，terms 回填就是\"路径相关\"的——只有走 index_repo 才生效。\n      if (existing && existing.sha256 === hash && !docEntriesNeedBackfill(store.entries[rel])) {\n        return `Skipped (unchanged): ${rel}\\nAlready indexed with ${(store.entries[rel] || []).length} entry/entries.`\n      }\n\n      const entries = await buildDocEntries(rel, filePath, {\n        chunkChars: config.chunkChars,\n        maxChunks: config.maxChunksPerFile,\n        maxFileSizeMb: config.maxFileSizeMb,\n        maxPdfPages: config.maxPdfPages,\n      })\n      if (entries === null) {\n        return store.commit((s) => {\n          s.removeFile(rel)\n          return `Skipped: ${rel} looks like a reflection dump, not a document.`\n        })\n      }\n\n      return store.commit((s) => {\n        s.setEntries(rel, entries)\n        s.markFile(rel, { sha256: hash, size, type: 'doc', indexedAt: new Date().toISOString() })\n        const preview = entries\n          .map((e) => `  - ${e.title} @ ${rel}:${e.sourceLine}`)\n          .join('\\n')\n        return `Indexed: ${rel}\\nEntries: ${entries.length}\\n${preview}`\n      })\n    },\n  })\n}"
    },
    {
      "path": "src/tools/watch-repo.js",
      "content": "import { defineTool } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools'\nimport path from 'node:path'\nimport { assertIndexRoot, assertSafeRoot, isUnsafeRoot, memoryRootFor, sessionMemoryRootOrNull } from '../util/fs.js'\nimport { ProjectMemoryStore } from '../store.js'\n\nexport function watchRepoTool(watchManager, config) {\n  return defineTool({\n    name: 'watch_repo',\n    description:\n      'Auto-refresh a project on change; watch=false stops.',\n    parameters: {\n      root: {\n        type: 'string',\n        required: true,\n        description: '项目根（绝对路径）',\n      },\n      watch: {\n        type: 'boolean',\n        description: 'false = 停止监听',\n      },\n    },\n    output: {\n      schema: { type: 'string' },\n      render: (_args, value) => [{ type: 'text', text: value }],\n    },\n    async execute(args, exec) {\n      const root = path.resolve(args.root)\n      // 不存在的根不写进 watchlist：watch 每轮会 commit → save → mkdirSync，把它重新造出来。\n      // 根是**文件**时同样要拦：否则 save() 的 mkdirSync 会抛裸 ENOTDIR。\n      // 家目录 / 系统目录 / Homebrew 前缀也不监听：整体轮询扫描会吃满内存（issue #5）。\n      if (args.watch !== false) {\n        try {\n          assertIndexRoot(root, args.root)\n          assertSafeRoot(root, { requested: args.root, allowUnsafe: config?.allowUnsafeRoots === true })\n        } catch (err) {\n          return `Not watching: ${err.message}`\n        }\n      }\n      const memoryDir = memoryRootFor(root, config.memoryDir)\n      // 会话记忆根与工具侧同一套解析（标记优先 → 会话 cwd）；拿不到就跳过镜像。\n      const sessionRoot = sessionMemoryRootOrNull(exec, config)\n      const sessionMemoryDir = sessionRoot ? memoryRootFor(sessionRoot, config.memoryDir) : null\n\n      const mirrorSessionWatchlist = async (present) => {\n        // 会话根不可用（家目录/系统目录且无标记）时跳过镜像：那会在不该有项目记忆的目录里\n        // 造出 watch.json，而 watch.json 一旦落在那里，下次以该目录为 cwd 启动又会把它读回来。\n        if (!sessionRoot || !sessionMemoryDir) return\n        if (path.resolve(sessionMemoryDir) === path.resolve(memoryDir)) return\n        const sessionStore = new ProjectMemoryStore(sessionMemoryDir).load()\n        const removed = sessionStore.removeWatch(root)\n        const added = present ? sessionStore.addWatch(root) : false\n        if (removed || added) sessionStore.save()\n      }\n\n      if (args.watch === false) {\n        watchManager.removeRoot(root)\n        // 危险根的 store 一律不读不写：load() 一个历史遗留的超大 store 光读盘就能 OOM\n        // （这正是要修的场景），而写它会在家目录里造出 .dsh-project-memory。那份\n        // watch.json 现在也没有任何启动路径会读取（restorePersisted 只认会话 cwd），\n        // 留着即可；会话侧的镜像条目照常摘掉。\n        if (!isUnsafeRoot(root)) {\n          new ProjectMemoryStore(memoryDir).load().commit((s) => s.removeWatch(root))\n        }\n        await mirrorSessionWatchlist(false)\n        return `Stopped watching: ${root}`\n      }\n      new ProjectMemoryStore(memoryDir).load().commit((s) => s.addWatch(root))\n      await mirrorSessionWatchlist(true)\n      watchManager.addRoot(root)\n      watchManager.start(config.watchInterval * 1000)\n      return `Watching ${root} (interval ${config.watchInterval}s). Docs/code changes will be re-indexed silently.`\n    },\n  })\n}"
    },
    {
      "path": "src/tools/stats.js",
      "content": "import { defineTool } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools'\nimport { assertIndexRoot, memoryRootFor, resolveSafeIndexRoot } from '../util/fs.js'\nimport { ProjectMemoryStore, storeOverview } from '../store.js'\nimport { cfgInsight, defaultGlobalFile, GlobalStore } from '../insight-store.js'\nimport { cfgEngine } from '../auto-inject.js'\nimport { resolveVectorLayer, vectorIndexSummary, vectorItemsFrom } from '../vector-index.js'\nimport { truncate } from '../util/text.js'\n\nconst TOP_N = 30\n\nexport function statsTool(config) {\n  return defineTool({\n    name: 'memory_stats',\n    description:\n      'Show store totals, last index time and the per-file index list.',\n    parameters: {\n      root: {\n        type: 'string',\n        description: '项目根（默认当前工作目录）',\n      },\n    },\n    output: {\n      schema: { type: 'string' },\n      render: (_args, value) => [{ type: 'text', text: value }],\n    },\n    async execute(args, exec) {\n      const root = resolveSafeIndexRoot(exec, args.root, config)\n      // 读路径也要验根存在：可选的向量层（leanvec）在索引空 store 时会落盘 vectors 缓存，\n      // 于是\"传错一个 root\"就能在任意可写位置造出 `<root>/.dsh-project-memory` —— 而回报\n      // 只是\"空 store\"，看起来像\"这个项目没有记忆\"。与 index_repo/watch_repo 同一道护栏。\n      assertIndexRoot(root, args.root || root)\n      const store = new ProjectMemoryStore(memoryRootFor(root, config.memoryDir)).load()\n      const overview = storeOverview(store)\n      const files = Object.entries(store.files).sort((a, b) => String(b[1].indexedAt || '').localeCompare(String(a[1].indexedAt || '')))\n      const lines = [\n        `Memory store: ${store.dir}`,\n        `Files indexed: ${overview.files} | Entries: ${overview.entries} | Experience notes: ${overview.experience}`,\n        overview.latest ? `Last index: ${overview.latest}` : 'Last index: never',\n      ]\n      if (files.length) {\n        lines.push('')\n        for (const [rel, rec] of files.slice(0, TOP_N)) {\n          const count = (store.entries[rel] || []).length\n          lines.push(`- ${rel} [${rec.type}] entries: ${count}, indexed at ${rec.indexedAt || 'unknown'}`)\n        }\n        if (files.length > TOP_N) lines.push(`- ... ${files.length - TOP_N} more files`)\n      }\n      // 可选向量层的**状态**（不含模型加载）：这一层静默降级太厉害——`vectorDir` 拼错一个\n      // 字母与\"没装 leanvec\"在输出上完全一样，而两者的语义差别是\"排序里有没有语义\"。\n      // 只报三件可判定的东西：能不能用、缓存索引对不对得上、写入去重开没开。\n      {\n        const engine = cfgEngine(config)\n        const off = typeof engine.vectorDir === 'string' && engine.vectorDir.trim().toLowerCase() === 'off'\n        let resolved = { dir: null }\n        try { resolved = off ? { dir: null } : await resolveVectorLayer(engine.vectorDir) } catch { resolved = { dir: null } }\n        const memDir = memoryRootFor(root, config.memoryDir)\n        const cfgI = cfgInsight(config)\n        const globalStore = new GlobalStore(cfgI.globalFile || defaultGlobalFile()).load()\n        const vs = vectorIndexSummary({ dir: memDir, items: vectorItemsFrom(store, globalStore) })\n        const state = resolved?.dir ? `on (leanvec @ ${resolved.dir})` : off ? \"off (vectorDir: 'off')\" : 'off (leanvec 未解析到)'\n        lines.push('')\n        lines.push(`Vector: ${state} | re-rank alpha ${engine.vectorAlpha} | write-dedup ${engine.vectorDedup ? 'on' : 'off'}`)\n        lines.push(\n          vs.rows\n            ? `Vector index: ${vs.rows} rows · ${vs.live} live / ${vs.stale} stale · ${(vs.bytes / 1024).toFixed(0)} KB · model ${vs.model || '?'} · updated ${vs.updatedAt || '?'}`\n            : 'Vector index: 尚未建立（首次查询/写入时构建）',\n        )\n      }\n      return truncate(lines.join('\\n'), config.maxOutputChars)\n    },\n  })\n}\n"
    },
    {
      "path": "src/tools/query-memory.js",
      "content": "import { defineTool } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools'\nimport path from 'node:path'\nimport { assertIndexRoot, memoryDirName, memoryRootFor, nestedStoreRoots, resolveSafeIndexRoot } from '../util/fs.js'\nimport { ProjectMemoryStore, storeOverview } from '../store.js'\nimport { expandQuery } from '../llm.js'\nimport { resolveRoute } from '../llm-route.js'\nimport { GlobalStore, cfgInsight, defaultGlobalFile, recordHit } from '../insight-store.js'\nimport { recallItems } from '../recall.js'\nimport { cfgEngine } from '../auto-inject.js'\nimport { createVectorRerank, vectorItemsFrom } from '../vector-index.js'\nimport { resolveLinkedSymbols } from '../link.js'\nimport { truncate } from '../util/text.js'\nimport { stepContent, stepStatus } from '../util/task-view.js'\nfunction toAbs(root, rel) {\n  return path.isAbsolute(rel) ? rel : path.join(root, rel)\n}\n\n/**\n * 本根未命中记忆层时，把\"这里有哪几个独立子索引\"告诉模型。\n *\n * 父根不再重复保存子项目的内容（`walkDir()` 跳过自带 store 的嵌套根），所以\"在父根下问子项目的\n * 事\"必然查不到；换 `root=` 再问一次是唯一正确的下一步。只在未命中时算，不在热路径上。\n */\nfunction nestedIndexNote(root, config) {\n  const nested = nestedStoreRoots(root, memoryDirName(config))\n  if (!nested.length) return ''\n  return (\n    `\\n\\nNote: this root keeps no copy of ${nested.length} nested project(s) — each has its own index. ` +\n    'Re-run query_memory with `root: <path>` for the one you want:\\n' +\n    nested.map((p) => `- ${p}`).join('\\n')\n  )\n}\n\n/**\n * 一段结果里最佳条目的跨层排序分（`rel × 层先验`，与 `recallItems` 返回的 `flat.hint`\n * 同一口径）。只用于决定段落先后，不参与打分，也不改变任何条目自身的 score。\n */\nfunction bestHint(hits) {\n  let best = 0\n  for (const h of hits || []) best = Math.max(best, (h.rel || 0) * (h.prior || 1))\n  return best\n}\n\n/** 被覆盖字段的上一版：只显示一行，方便模型判断是否写回；空槽不占位。 */\nfunction previousLine(item) {\n  if (!item || !item.prev || typeof item.prev !== 'object' || Array.isArray(item.prev)) return ''\n  const parts = []\n  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(item.prev)) {\n    if (value === undefined || value === null || value === '') continue\n    const raw = typeof value === 'string' ? value : JSON.stringify(value)\n    const text = raw ? raw.replace(/\\s+/g, ' ').trim() : ''\n    if (!text) continue\n    parts.push(`${key}=${text}`)\n  }\n  return parts.length ? parts.join('; ').slice(0, 300) : ''\n}\n\nexport function queryMemoryTool(ctx, config) {\n  return defineTool({\n    name: 'query_memory',\n    description:\n      'Search project memory: docs, symbols, experience and insights. Returns cited sources or insight ids. '\n      + 'Use before grepping for orientation, a spec constraint, or a past decision.',\n    parameters: {\n      query: {\n        type: 'string',\n        required: true,\n        description: 'What to look for',\n      },\n      root: {\n        type: 'string',\n        description: '项目根（默认当前工作目录）',\n      },\n      type: {\n        type: 'string',\n        enum: ['all', 'doc', 'symbol', 'experience', 'insight', 'task'],\n        description: 'all|doc|symbol|experience|insight|task；默认 all',\n      },\n      limit: {\n        type: 'number',\n        description: '最多返回条数，默认 8',\n      },\n    },\n    output: {\n      schema: { type: 'string' },\n      render: (_args, value) => [{ type: 'text', text: value }],\n    },\n    async execute(args, exec) {\n      const root = resolveSafeIndexRoot(exec, args.root, config)\n      // 读路径也要验根存在。这条不是洁癖：可选的向量层（leanvec）在空 store 上会建\n      // `<root>/.dsh-project-memory/vectors.json`，于是传错一个 root（拼写错误/旧路径）就能\n      // 在任意可写位置造出目录和空 store，而回报是\"No memory matches\"——看起来像\"这个项目\n      // 没有记忆\"，用户不会意识到自己查错了地方。与 index_repo/watch_repo 同一道护栏。\n      assertIndexRoot(root, args.root || root)\n      // 空查询不是\"全部\"：recallItems 会过滤空串，rankEntriesStreaming 随即返回\n      // entries.slice(0, limit)（任意条目、分数 0），task 分支的 includes('') 更是命中所有任务。\n      if (!String(args.query ?? '').trim()) {\n        return 'query must not be empty. Use memory_stats to see what the store contains.'\n      }\n      const store = new ProjectMemoryStore(memoryRootFor(root, config.memoryDir)).load()\n      const type = args.type || 'all'\n      const limit = Math.max(1, Math.min(Number(args.limit) || 8, 20))\n\n      const queries = config.llmQueryExpansion\n        ? await expandQuery(ctx.llm, args.query, config.expansionCount, { route: resolveRoute(exec, config) })\n        : [args.query]\n\n      // 会话绑定决定 task 级 insight 的可见性；global 级始终可见。\n      const sessionId = exec?.agent?.session?.id\n      const boundTaskId = sessionId && typeof store.getBoundTaskId === 'function' ? store.getBoundTaskId(sessionId) : null\n      const globalStore = new GlobalStore(cfgInsight(config).globalFile || defaultGlobalFile()).load()\n      const wantMemory = type === 'all' || type === 'doc' || type === 'symbol'\n      /** 本根记忆层（doc/symbol）的命中数：0 且存在子索引时，末尾要指路。 */\n      let memHitCount = 0\n      const wantInsight = type === 'all' || type === 'insight'\n      // 可选向量层：**没装/没配就是 null**，此时 recallItems 拿到 rerank:null 与纯词法路径逐字段一致。\n      // 只影响 experience/insight 两层的排序（doc/symbol 与返回条数都不变）。\n      const cfg = cfgEngine(config)\n      const rerank = await createVectorRerank({\n        storeDir: memoryRootFor(root, config.memoryDir),\n        items: vectorItemsFrom(store, globalStore),\n        vectorDir: cfg.vectorDir,\n        alpha: cfg.vectorAlpha,\n      })\n      // 一次 recall 覆盖全部层：doc/symbol/experience/insight 共用同一个检索核心（src/recall.js）。\n      const recalled = recallItems({\n        store,\n        globalStore,\n        queries,\n        boundTaskId,\n        limit,\n        rerank,\n        layers: [\n          ...(wantMemory ? (type === 'symbol' ? ['symbol'] : type === 'doc' ? ['doc'] : ['doc', 'symbol']) : []),\n          ...(wantInsight ? ['insight'] : []),\n          ...(type === 'all' || type === 'experience' ? ['experience'] : []),\n        ],\n      })\n\n      const lines = []\n      // 结果段先按相关性排序，最后再拼进 lines（见下方 sections.sort）。\n      const sections = []\n      // 使用记账：检索命中也是\"被用到\"（活跃度/衰减用得上它，见 recordHit）。查询是热路径\n      // （p50 2.6ms），这里只改内存 + 标脏，**不**强制落盘——注入路径会立即落盘，这条路\n      // 靠下一次自然 save 带上。记账失败绝不影响查询结果。\n      // 经验层同源（kind:'experience' 的 insight），所以两桶都要记：`insightId` 是 insight\n      // 适配器带的键，经验桶给的是原始条目，用 `id` 兜底。\n      for (const layer of ['insight', 'experience']) {\n        if (layer === 'insight' && !wantInsight) continue\n        if (layer === 'experience' && !(type === 'all' || type === 'experience')) continue\n        try {\n          const bucket = recalled.layers.find((l) => l.layer === layer)\n          recordHit({ store, globalStore, ids: (bucket?.hits || []).map((h) => h.item?.insightId || h.item?.id) })\n        } catch {\n          /* ignore：记账是旁路 */\n        }\n      }\n      if (wantMemory) {\n        // doc/symbol 的原始 BM25 分不可直接比：符号正文短，同等相关时分会更高/更低，\n        // 用原始分排序会让一层把另一层整体挤掉。先按**层内相对分 rel** 排序，并在\n        // limit≥2 时各保留一条，剩余名额再按 rel 填。\n        const docHits = recalled.layers.find((l) => l.layer === 'doc')?.hits || []\n        const symbolHits = recalled.layers.find((l) => l.layer === 'symbol')?.hits || []\n        const byRel = (a, b) => (b.rel || 0) - (a.rel || 0) || (b.weightedScore || 0) - (a.weightedScore || 0)\n        const merged = [...docHits, ...symbolHits].sort(byRel)\n        const picked = []\n        const seenHits = new Set()\n        const take = (h) => {\n          if (!h || picked.length >= limit) return\n          const key = h.item?.id || `${h.item?.type}:${h.item?.title}`\n          if (seenHits.has(key)) return\n          seenHits.add(key)\n          picked.push(h)\n        }\n        if (limit >= 2) {\n          for (const h of [docHits[0], symbolHits[0]].filter(Boolean).sort(byRel)) take(h)\n        }\n        for (const h of merged) take(h)\n        const memHits = picked\n        memHitCount = memHits.length\n        if (memHits.length) {\n          const block = [`## Memory (${type === 'all' ? 'docs + symbols' : type})`]\n          for (const { item: e, rel } of memHits) {\n            const absSource = e.sourceLine ? `${toAbs(root, e.sourcePath)}:${e.sourceLine}` : toAbs(root, e.sourcePath)\n            const score = Math.round((rel || 0) * 100)\n            // 符号没有 summary：它的正文就是一行声明。缺正文时退到标题，绝不输出 `- undefined`。\n            const body = e.type === 'symbol' ? (e.text || e.title) : e.summary\n            const summaryLine = body ? `\\n- ${body}` : ''\n            // 条目状态占位（可证伪状态机落地前恒为 exact）。\n            // 先立字段，后续状态机到位时只改值、不改输出契约。\n            block.push(`### ${e.title} (score: ${score})\\n- source: ${absSource}\\n- status: ${e.status || 'exact'}${summaryLine}`)\n            if (e.type === 'doc') {\n              // 读取期解算：链接不落盘，按当前符号表排序取前 5（见 src/link.js）\n              const refs = resolveLinkedSymbols(store, e, 5).map(\n                (s) => `${s.title} @ ${toAbs(root, s.sourcePath)}:${s.sourceLine}`,\n              )\n              if (refs.length) block.push(`- references: ${refs.join('; ')}`)\n            }\n          }\n          sections.push({ block, best: bestHint(memHits) })\n        }\n      }\n      if (wantInsight) {\n        const bucket = recalled.layers.find((l) => l.layer === 'insight')\n        if (bucket && bucket.hits.length) {\n          const block = ['## Insights (lessons / decisions / procedures)']\n          for (const { item: e, rel } of bucket.hits) {\n            const scope = e.scope ? `, scope: ${e.scope}` : ''\n            const files = e.files && e.files.length ? `\\n- files: ${e.files.map((f) => toAbs(root, f)).join(', ')}` : ''\n            const conf = typeof e.confidence === 'number' ? `\\n- confidence: ${e.confidence}` : ''\n            const previous = previousLine(e)\n            block.push(\n              `### ${e.title} (score: ${Math.round(rel * 100)}, kind: ${e.kind}${scope}, id: ${e.insightId})\\n- ${e.summary}${files}${conf}${previous ? `\\n- previous: ${previous}` : ''}`,\n            )\n          }\n          sections.push({ block, best: bestHint(bucket.hits) })\n        }\n      }\n      if (type === 'all' || type === 'experience') {\n        const expBucket = recalled.layers.find((l) => l.layer === 'experience')\n        if (expBucket && expBucket.hits.length) {\n          const block = ['## Experience (past problems -> solutions)']\n          for (const { item: e, rel } of expBucket.hits) {\n            // 统一存储后经验条目就是 insight：导入时 source_file 落在 files[0]，新写的也走同一处。\n            const src = e.sourceFile || (Array.isArray(e.files) ? e.files[0] : '')\n            const source = src ? ` (source: ${toAbs(root, src)})` : ''\n            // `problem`/`solution` 只是 v0.4 的字段形状：`save_lesson` 写 kind:'experience'\n            // 时没有这两个参数（正文在 fix/choice/body 里），直接用会渲染出 `undefined`。\n            const problem = e.problem || e.title || '(untitled)'\n            const solution = e.solution || e.fix || e.choice || e.body || '(no text)'\n            block.push(\n              `### Problem: ${problem} (score: ${Math.round(rel * 100)}, id: ${e.id})\\n- solution: ${solution}${source}\\n- updated: ${e.updatedAt}`,\n            )\n          }\n          sections.push({ block, best: bestHint(expBucket.hits) })\n        }\n      }\n\n      // 段落顺序按相关性，而不是写死的 docs 优先：检索已经给出跨层 hint（rel × 层先验），\n      // 排版照它来。否则查一条明确的记忆时，无关的长文档会排在最前、正确答案埋在几千字符\n      // 之后——模型很可能根本没读到。sort 稳定，同分保持 memory → insight → experience。\n      sections.sort((a, b) => b.best - a.best)\n      for (const s of sections) for (const line of s.block) lines.push(line)\n\n      // TaskBridge: type:'task' 专门查任务记录；type:'all' 尾部附一行任务计数提示\n      const tasks = store.tasks || []\n      if (type === 'task') {\n        const q = (queries[0] || '').toLowerCase()\n        const matched = tasks\n          .filter((t) => !t.archived && (t.title.toLowerCase().includes(q) || (t.steps || []).some((s) => stepContent(s).toLowerCase().includes(q)) || (t.files || []).some((f) => f.toLowerCase().includes(q))))\n          .slice(0, limit)\n        if (!matched.length) {\n          return `任务记录: 0 套匹配 \"${args.query}\"（list_tasks 查看全部，select_task 续做）`\n        }\n        for (const t of matched) {\n          const done = (t.steps || []).filter((s) => stepStatus(s) === 'completed').length\n          const total = (t.steps || []).length\n          const stepsText = (t.steps || []).length\n            ? (t.steps || []).map((s) => `- [${stepStatus(s) === 'completed' ? 'x' : stepStatus(s) === 'in_progress' ? '*' : ' '}] ${stepContent(s)}`).join('\\n')\n            : '（无步骤）'\n          const files = (t.files || []).slice(0, 8).join(', ')\n          lines.push(`### ${t.title} (${done}/${total} 完成)\\n${stepsText}\\n- 文件: ${files || '无'}`)\n        }\n        return truncate(lines.join('\\n\\n'), config.maxOutputChars)\n      }\n      if (type === 'all' && tasks.length) {\n        lines.push(`任务记录: ${tasks.length} 套（list_tasks 查看，select_task 续做）`)\n      }\n\n      if (!lines.length) {\n        const overview = storeOverview(store)\n        const hint =\n          type === 'experience'\n            ? 'Note a fix with remember so it can be recalled next time.'\n            : type === 'insight'\n              ? 'Save a lesson / decision / procedure with save_lesson so it can be recalled next time.'\n              : type === 'all'\n                ? 'Index it first with index_repo / index_doc, or note a fix with remember or save_lesson.'\n                : 'Index it first with index_repo / index_doc.'\n        const tail =\n          overview.files === 0\n            ? '. The store has never been indexed.'\n            : overview.latest\n              ? `, last indexed at ${overview.latest}. Use memory_stats to see what the store contains.`\n              : '. Use memory_stats to see what the store contains.'\n        const nestedNote = wantMemory && memHitCount === 0 ? nestedIndexNote(root, config) : ''\n        return (\n          `No memory matches for \"${args.query}\" in ${root}. ${hint}\\n` +\n          `Store overview: ${overview.files} files indexed, ${overview.entries} entries, ${overview.experience} experience notes${tail}${nestedNote}`\n        )\n      }\n      // 提示放在**最前**：`truncate()` 截的是尾部，而 insight/procedure 类条目单条就能到 600+\n      // 字符，放末尾会被整段截掉（实测 8000 字符预算下必被截）。\n      const note = wantMemory && memHitCount === 0 ? nestedIndexNote(root, config).trimStart() + '\\n\\n' : ''\n      return truncate(note + lines.join('\\n\\n'), config.maxOutputChars)\n    },\n  })\n}"

      "content": "import { defineTool } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools'\nimport { assertIndexRoot, memoryRootFor, normalizeCitationFiles, resolveSafeIndexRoot } from '../util/fs.js'\nimport { ProjectMemoryStore } from '../store.js'\nimport { cfgInsight, saveInsight, GlobalStore, defaultGlobalFile } from '../insight-store.js'\nimport { ensureGlobalInit } from '../global-seed.js'\nimport { vectorItemsFrom } from '../vector-index.js'\nimport { createWriteCosine } from '../auto-inject.js'\n\nexport function rememberTool(config) {\n  return defineTool({\n    name: 'remember',\n    description:\n      'Save a problem→solution note as kind:experience; same dedup as save_lesson. '\n      + 'Prefer save_lesson for anything that is not a problem→solution note.',\n    parameters: {\n      problem: {\n        type: 'string',\n        required: true,\n        description: '问题/现象',\n      },\n      solution: {\n        type: 'string',\n        required: true,\n        description: '具体解法',\n      },\n      root: {\n        type: 'string',\n        description: '项目根（默认当前工作目录）',\n      },\n      source_file: {\n        type: 'string',\n        description: '关联文件（项目相对）',\n      },\n    },\n    output: {\n      schema: { type: 'string' },\n      render: (_args, value) => [{ type: 'text', text: value }],\n    },\n    async execute(args, exec) {\n      const root = resolveSafeIndexRoot(exec, args.root, config)\n      // 写盘前校验根：否则一个拼错的 root 会被 mkdir 成字面量目录（连同 .dsh-project-memory）。\n      assertIndexRoot(root, args.root || root)\n      const memoryDir = memoryRootFor(root, config.memoryDir)\n      const store = new ProjectMemoryStore(memoryDir).load()\n      const cfg = cfgInsight(config)\n      // 与 save_lesson 同一条约束：files 只收项目内相对路径，项目外/逃出根的丢弃并回报。\n      const citation = normalizeCitationFiles(args.source_file ? [args.source_file] : [], root)\n      ensureGlobalInit(config) // 幂等：project 写入可能被自动提升到 global\n      const globalStore = new GlobalStore(cfg.globalFile || defaultGlobalFile()).load()\n      // 与 save_lesson 同一条写入路径 ⇒ 同一套去重/自动覆盖/近邻提示；没装 leanvec 时 `cosine` 为 null，\n      // 退回纯词法（与旧版经验层行为一致）。\n      const cosine = await createWriteCosine(config, { storeDir: memoryDir, items: vectorItemsFrom(store, globalStore) })\n      const raw = {\n        title: args.problem,\n        kind: 'experience',\n        problem: args.problem,\n        solution: args.solution,\n        files: citation.files.length ? citation.files : undefined,\n        confidence: 1,\n      }\n      let result\n      store.commit((s) => {\n        result = saveInsight({ store: s, globalStore, raw, scope: 'project', cfg, source: 'agent', cosine })\n        return result\n      })\n      globalStore.commit()\n      if (!result || !result.ok) return `Failed: ${result?.error || '写入未完成'}`\n      const verb = result.action === 'created' ? 'Saved' : 'Updated existing'\n      const dropped = citation.dropped.length\n        ? `\\n（${citation.dropped.length} 个 source_file 不是项目内路径，已丢弃）`\n        : ''\n      return `${verb} experience note (${result.id}).${result.hint ? ` ${result.hint}` : ''}${dropped}`\n    },\n  })\n}\n"

      "content": "import { defineTool } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools'\nimport { assertIndexRoot, memoryRootFor, normalizeCitationFiles, resolveSafeIndexRoot } from '../util/fs.js'\nimport { ProjectMemoryStore } from '../store.js'\nimport { truncate } from '../util/text.js'\nimport { cfgInsight, saveInsight, defaultGlobalFile, GlobalStore } from '../insight-store.js'\nimport { ensureGlobalInit } from '../global-seed.js'\nimport { INSIGHT_KINDS, INSIGHT_SCOPES } from '../insight-store.js'\nimport { sessionIdOf } from '../util/task-view.js'\nimport { createVectorRerank, vectorItemsFrom } from '../vector-index.js'\nimport { createWriteCosine } from '../auto-inject.js'\n\nexport function lessonTool(config) {\n  const kindDesc = 'lesson(坑→改法) | decision(选择+理由) | procedure(步骤) | experience(问题→解法)；默认 lesson。'\n  const scopeDesc =\n    'task(任务私有) | project(项目资产) | global(跨项目)；默认 project；给 id 时就地更新。'\n  return defineTool({\n    name: 'save_lesson',\n    description:\n      '写入一条教训 / 决策 / 流程（单条 insight）。写入前与既有记忆比对：高相似度自动覆盖（旧值留在 prev），'\n      + '较近的提示近邻 id。发现记错/过时：带 id 再写一次即就地覆盖；确定要删用 forget。',\n    parameters: {\n      id: { type: 'string', description: '既有条目 id（就地更新，忽略 scope）' },\n      title: { type: 'string', description: '一行标题' },\n      kind: { type: 'string', enum: INSIGHT_KINDS, description: kindDesc },\n      scope: { type: 'string', enum: INSIGHT_SCOPES, description: scopeDesc },\n      pattern: { type: 'string', description: '错误模式' },\n      fix: { type: 'string', description: '修正做法' },\n      choice: { type: 'string', description: '选了什么' },\n      reason: { type: 'string', description: '为什么' },\n      steps: { type: 'array', items: { type: 'string' }, description: '有序步骤' },\n      trigger: {\n        type: 'object',\n        additionalProperties: false,\n        properties: {\n          when: {\n            type: 'object',\n            additionalProperties: false,\n            properties: {\n              ops: { type: 'array', items: { type: 'string' }, description: 'file-write|file-delete|shell-run|git-commit|git-push|release|npm-publish|deploy|migrate|render-doc|index-doc|read-image|fetch-web|run-bench|query-memory' },\n              writes: { type: 'array', items: { type: 'string' }, description: '项目相对路径，禁 glob' },\n              intents: { type: 'array', items: { type: 'string' }, description: '意图词（CJK≥2，拉丁≥5）' },\n            },\n            description: '唯一触发面：三者取或。',\n          },\n          guard: {\n            type: 'object',\n            additionalProperties: false,\n            properties: {\n              paths: { type: 'array', items: { type: 'string' }, description: '写目标须命中其一' },\n              not_paths: { type: 'array', items: { type: 'string' } },\n              hosts: { type: 'array', items: { type: 'string' }, description: '如 wsl' },\n              tags: { type: 'array', items: { type: 'string' }, description: '画像 tag 交集' },\n            },\n            description: '收窄条件：全部满足才放行。',\n          },\n          prevents: { type: 'string', description: '不知道它会做错什么' },\n          // 旧字段：历史条目与旧调用仍可能带它们，保留形状但不占描述预算。\n          keywords: { type: 'array', items: { type: 'string' } },\n          symbols: { type: 'array', items: { type: 'string' } },\n          actions: { type: 'array', items: { type: 'string' } },\n          paths: { type: 'array', items: { type: 'string' } },\n          scope: { type: 'array', items: { type: 'string' } },\n        },\n        description: '命中即在动手前注入；when 是唯一触发面，guard 只能收窄。',\n      },\n      task_id: { type: 'string', description: '目标任务 id' },\n      files: { type: 'array', items: { type: 'string' }, description: '关联文件（项目相对）' },\n      symbols: { type: 'array', items: { type: 'string' }, description: '关联符号' },\n      confidence: { type: 'number', description: '0..1' },\n      root: { type: 'string', description: '项目根' },\n    },\n    output: { schema: { type: 'string' }, render: (_a, v) => [{ type: 'text', text: v }] },\n    async execute(args, exec) {\n      const root = resolveSafeIndexRoot(exec, args.root, config)\n      assertIndexRoot(root, args.root || root)\n      // 写入期约束：files 只收项目内相对路径（schema 早就这么承诺，此前没有校验）。\n      const citationFiles = normalizeCitationFiles(args.files, root)\n      const memoryDir = memoryRootFor(root, config.memoryDir)\n      const store = new ProjectMemoryStore(memoryDir).load()\n      const cfg = cfgInsight(config)\n      const sid = sessionIdOf(exec)\n      const boundTaskId = sid ? store.getBoundTaskId(sid) : undefined\n      const taskId = args.task_id || boundTaskId\n\n      const raw = {\n        id: args.id,\n        title: args.title,\n        kind: args.kind,\n        pattern: args.pattern,\n        fix: args.fix,\n        choice: args.choice,\n        reason: args.reason,\n        steps: args.steps,\n        trigger: args.trigger,\n        files: citationFiles.files,\n        symbols: args.symbols,\n        confidence: args.confidence,\n      }\n      // 就地更新只要求 id（可以只改一个字段）；新建仍然要求有个能当标题的东西。\n      if (!args.id && !raw.title && !raw.pattern && !raw.choice) {\n        return truncate(JSON.stringify({ success: false, error: '需要 title / pattern / choice 之一（或给 id 做就地更新）' }), config.maxOutputChars || 8000)\n      }\n      if (!INSIGHT_KINDS.includes(raw.kind)) raw.kind = 'lesson'\n\n      let scope = args.scope\n      if (!scope) scope = taskId ? 'task' : 'project'\n      if (!args.id && scope === 'task' && !taskId) {\n        return truncate(JSON.stringify({ success: false, error: 'task 级写入需要 task_id（或先 select_task 绑定会话）' }), config.maxOutputChars || 8000)\n      }\n\n      ensureGlobalInit(config) // 幂等确保 global 文件结构就绪\n      const globalStore = new GlobalStore(cfg.globalFile || defaultGlobalFile()).load()\n\n      // 可选向量层：**没装/没配就是 null**，此时 saveInsight 逐字段退回原来的纯词法行为。\n      // 就地更新（给了 id）不需要比对，跳过它可以省掉一次模型加载（~118ms / ~120MB）。\n      let cosine = null\n      if (!args.id) {\n        cosine = await createWriteCosine(config, { storeDir: memoryDir, items: vectorItemsFrom(store, globalStore) })\n      }\n\n      let result\n      store.commit((s) => {\n        result = saveInsight({ store: s, globalStore, raw, scope, taskId, cfg, source: 'agent', cosine })\n        return result\n      })\n      // global 变更（global scope 直写或 project 自动提升）单独落盘\n      globalStore.commit()\n      if (!result) result = { ok: false, error: '写入未完成' }\n      const body = result.ok\n        ? `Saved insight ${result.id} [scope=${result.scope || scope}] action=${result.action}${result.hint ? ` — ${result.hint}` : ''}`\n        : `Failed: ${result.error}`\n      // 丢弃必须说出来：静默少几行引用，事后只能靠审计发现\"查不到\"。\n      const note = citationFiles.dropped.length\n        ? `\\n（${citationFiles.dropped.length} 个 files 既不是项目内相对路径也不是项目内绝对路径，已丢弃：${citationFiles.dropped.slice(0, 3).join(', ')}${citationFiles.dropped.length > 3 ? ' …' : ''}）`\n        : ''\n      return truncate(body + note, config.maxOutputChars || 8000)\n    },\n  })\n}\n"

      "path": "src/tools/forget.js",
      "content": "import { defineTool } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools'\nimport { assertIndexRoot, memoryRootFor, resolveSafeIndexRoot } from '../util/fs.js'\nimport { ProjectMemoryStore } from '../store.js'\nimport { cfgInsight, DELETED_KEEP, GlobalStore, defaultGlobalFile, removeMemory } from '../insight-store.js'\nimport { forgetVectorRows } from '../vector-index.js'\n\n/** 回报用的一行：`ins_xxx《标题》(project)`。标题已在 removeMemory 里截断。 */\nfunction line(e) {\n  return `${e.id}《${e.title}》(${e.home})`\n}\n\n/**\n * 删除留痕的回报后缀：把留痕文件的**真实路径**直接写进结果。\n *\n * 为什么不只写在工具描述里、而是每次删除都回报：描述是静态文本，说不清项目目录在哪\n * （`memoryDir` 可配、项目根随会话变）；而模型要\"自己去找\"就必须先知道路径。这条不影响\n * 任何判据，只是把地址递到手里。\n * @param {{keptIn?: string[]}} res - removeMemory 的返回\n * @returns {string} 直接拼在删除回报后面的文本（无留痕时为空串）\n */\nfunction keptHint(res) {\n  const files = Array.isArray(res?.keptIn) ? res.keptIn : []\n  if (!files.length) return ''\n  return `\\nLast ${DELETED_KEEP} deleted entries kept for manual recovery (read them to restore, then save again):\\n`\n    + files.map((f) => `- ${f}`).join('\\n')\n}\n\nexport function forgetTool(config) {\n  return defineTool({\n    name: 'forget',\n    description:\n      'Delete memories by id or matching keywords, at task/project/global scope. Real deletion, no undo; '\n      + 'the last 5 deleted entries are kept in deleted.json. A keyword matching more than the cap deletes nothing '\n      + 'and lists the candidates instead.',\n    parameters: {\n      id_or_query: {\n        type: 'string',\n        required: true,\n        description: '精确 id 或关键词；id 优先',\n      },\n      root: {\n        type: 'string',\n        description: '项目根（默认当前工作目录）',\n      },\n    },\n    output: {\n      schema: { type: 'string' },\n      render: (_args, value) => [{ type: 'text', text: value }],\n    },\n    async execute(args, exec) {\n      const root = resolveSafeIndexRoot(exec, args.root, config)\n      assertIndexRoot(root, args.root || root)\n      const memoryDir = memoryRootFor(root, config.memoryDir)\n      const store = new ProjectMemoryStore(memoryDir).load()\n      const cfg = cfgInsight(config)\n      const globalStore = new GlobalStore(cfg.globalFile || defaultGlobalFile()).load()\n      let res\n      store.commit((s) => {\n        res = removeMemory({ store: s, globalStore, idOrQuery: args.id_or_query, maxMatches: cfg.maxForgetMatches })\n        return res\n      })\n      globalStore.commit() // global 侧若被删过才落盘\n      if (res && res.removed.length) {\n        // 向量缓存也是\"这条记忆\"的一部分：`vectors.json` 里那行是标题的 256 维均值池化，\n        // 留着就不算真删。这里不加载模型（只读文件 + 原子重写），失败也只是缓存残留。\n        try { forgetVectorRows({ dir: memoryDir, ids: res.removed.map((e) => e.id) }) } catch { /* 缓存删除失败不影响删除承诺 */ }\n      }\n      if (res && res.tooMany) {\n        const head = res.matches.slice(0, 10).map(line)\n        const more = res.matches.length > head.length ? ` …（共 ${res.matches.length} 条）` : ''\n        return `Matched ${res.matches.length} memories (cap ${cfg.maxForgetMatches}), removed none — narrow the query or delete by id:\\n` + head.map((l) => `- ${l}`).join('\\n') + more\n      }\n      if (!res || !res.ok || !res.removed.length) return 'No matching memory found.'\n      return `Removed ${res.removed.length} memory entries:\\n`\n        + res.removed.map((e) => `- ${line(e)}`).join('\\n')\n        + keptHint(res)\n    },\n  })\n}\n"

 if (!tasks.length) {\n        return '任务记录: 0 套（先做一步再建清单，或用 select_task 新建）'\n      }\n      const lines = ['## 任务记录']\n      for (const task of tasks) lines.push(summaryOf(task))\n schema: { type: 'string' }, render: (_a, v) => [{ type: 'text', text: v }] },\n    async execute(args, exec) {\n      const root = resolveSafeIndexRoot(exec, args.root, config)\n      assertIndexRoot(root, args.root || root)\n      const store = new ProjectMemoryStore(memoryRootFor(root, config.memoryDir)).load()\n      const sid = sessionIdOf(exec)\n      const now = new
